comments: After shift pattern policy changed , Old updated shift changed auto matically.

3. Additionally, I transferred the NetServer.dll file to the Windows --> SysWOW64 folder.

CD..
SysWOW64 regsvr32 NetServer.dll
5. After registering the executable, I opened the software and accessed the reader utility menu. Then, I selected the device and initiated the process to set the date and time.
6. The process was successfully completed, and the date and time were set accordingly.

name: iApp
description_plain: VMS System is not working at Ankleshwar site. unique key error when save the visitor gate pass.
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count: 
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

description_plain: On date 15.04.2024 out punch record is not found of Mr. Manish Oza , can you help me. Emp id : 137636 Name : Manisha Oza
comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance out punch is not appearing in the attendance sheet, despite the employee having already completed the out punch on the device.
2. Upon investigating, I accessed the employee master and edited the miscellaneous menu to review employee transactions. It was observed that only the in punch was recorded in the attendance data.
3. Subsequently, I accessed the database menu and confirmed that the device was active and functioning properly.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and navigated to the service log folder, where I retrieved the log data for the date of 15/04/2024.
5. Using the log extractor executable, I filtered the data with the card ID and identified the out punch for the particular card ID on that day.
6. I extracted the log folder containing the out punch data and pasted it into the recover file in the services folder.
7. Finally, I restarted the Spectra worker process and re-read the log folder. After some time, the out punch data began to appear in the attendance sheet.
solution:
1. The client reported that the attendance out punch is not appearing in the attendance sheet, despite the employee having already completed the out punch on the device.
2. Upon investigating, I accessed the employee master and edited the miscellaneous menu to review employee transactions. It was observed that only the in punch was recorded in the attendance data.
3. Subsequently, I accessed the database menu and confirmed that the device was active and functioning properly.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and navigated to the service log folder, where I retrieved the log data for the date of 15/04/2024.
5. Using the log extractor executable, I filtered the data with the card ID and identified the out punch for the particular card ID on that day.
6. I extracted the log folder containing the out punch data and pasted it into the recover file in the services folder.
7. Finally, I restarted the Spectra worker process and re-read the log folder. After some time, the out punch data began to appear in the attendance sheet.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Data synchronization with the FTP
comments: We have called user but due to they are having some function so they will connect tomorrow.
solution:
During the remote session with the user, we identified that they were utilizing a third-party configuration for live data transfer, sending all attendance data to an FTP server. However, starting from 17:00 PM on April 20th, the data failed to transfer to the FTP server. Upon inspecting the log file for April 20th, we noticed that there were no records after 17:00 PM, although the data for April 21st appeared to be intact.

To further investigate the issue, we examined the system's event log using the following steps:

Open Event Viewer by pressing Win + R (Run) and typing "eventvwr".
In the left pane of Event Viewer, navigate to "Windows Logs >> System."
In the middle pane, a list of events that occurred while Windows was running was displayed.
We discovered several relevant events in the system log and captured screenshots to present to the developer team for analysis.

Additionally, we took proactive measures to address the issue by generating a new third-party configuration for backup. This involved navigating to the "Attendance" section within the application, selecting "Configuration," then "Third Party Configuration," and finally saving the changes.

comments:

2. Upon initial inspection of the sanction applications page, both applications were indeed found to be pending at HR/Admin.
3. Subsequently, I reviewed the user logs to investigate further and discovered that although a shift change application was done after the misspunch application was applied, no shift change application was found for either employee.
4. Further examination of the sanction application rule revealed that the misspunch rule is dependent on the location code defined for the employees.
5. Upon accessing the employee master, it was noted that the location code was outdated for both employees. Consequently, I advised them to update the location code to the new one for both employees.

name: iApp
description_plain: When saving the visitor registration, a unique key constraint error appears on the menu.
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count: 
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

description_plain: Unique key error when save the registration details.
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%'   --569942
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count: 
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%'  --569941
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

description_plain: On date 07.04.2024 in punch record is not found of below Employee’s, kindly check. 138604- Mungara Ayush 134398- Panchal Kalpesh Kumar 1274 - Deepak Parmar 4683 - Mahesh Patel 137254 - Patel Ujaskumar Vinodbhai
comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance out punch is not appearing in the attendance sheet for lots of employees, despite the employees having already completed the out punch on the device. 
2. Upon investigating, I accessed the employee master and edited the miscellaneous menu to review employee transactions. It was observed that only the in punch was recorded in the attendance data. 
3. Subsequently, I accessed the database menu and confirmed that the device was active and functioning properly. 
4. I accessed the Zydus server and navigated to the service log folder, where I retrieved the log data for the date of 07/04/2024. 
5. Using the log extractor executable, I filtered the data with the card ID and identified the out punch for the particular card ID on that day. 
6. I extracted the log folder containing the out punch data and pasted it into the recover file in the services folder. 
7. Finally, I restarted the Spectra worker process and re-read the log folder. After some time, the out punch data began to appear in the attendance sheet.
solution:
1. The client reported that the attendance out punch is not appearing in the attendance sheet for lots of employees, despite the employees having already completed the out punch on the device.

3. Subsequently, I accessed the database menu and confirmed that the device was active and functioning properly. 
4. I accessed the Zydus server and navigated to the service log folder, where I retrieved the log data for the date of 07/04/2024. 
5. Using the log extractor executable, I filtered the data with the card ID and identified the out punch for the particular card ID on that day. 
6. I extracted the log folder containing the out punch data and pasted it into the recover file in the services folder. 
7. Finally, I restarted the Spectra worker process and re-read the log folder. After some time, the out punch data began to appear in the attendance sheet.

SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='115517' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
4. Following this, I reprocessed the attendance, allowing the client to successfully update the punch data.

name: iApp
description_plain: I wanted to bring to your attention that our VMS system has been showing that Mr. Shivam Karapurkar has been recorded 79 times recently. he is showing up at the front of the page every day and the visitor number remains the same. Could you please look into this matter and see if there is any issue with the system. (attached screen short )
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID.
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to May 6, 2024, and found more than 1000 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations.
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query:
Select * into Visitor_06052024 from Visitor
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs:
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='14' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query:
Delete from Visitor where id='575821'
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.
solution:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID.
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to May 6, 2024, and found more than 1000 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations.
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query:
Select * into Visitor_06052024 from Visitor
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs:
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='14' and Visitid='0000000000-1'

name: iApp
description_plain: Please go through the trail mail, we are facing issue in device server connectivity. We have checked lane connection with IT team and found ok but device not receiving signal. We need to provide turnstile data to HR to clear pending miss punch/card-forgotten request. Device IP- 172.24.115.14 Please resolve the issue asap.
comments:
1. As we checking from our end, we observed that the device IP is not showing as active in the Zydus server. Please refer to the screenshot below for your reference.
2. Additionally, kindly verify on the device itself whether the device IP, subnet mask, and gateway are properly configured. If not, please manually insert the network parameters.
solution:
1. The client reported that the turnstile device is malfunctioning and displaying an error.
2. After discussing with the client, it was determined that the issue stems from a hardware malfunction, prompting them to send the device back to our office for repairs.
3. Upon receiving the replacement device, the client needed guidance on configuring it, so I instructed them to input the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway into the device.
4. Once the device's IP address was successfully connected to the server, I attempted to update the device's MAC address in the software, but the process stalled and remained pending.
5. To troubleshoot, I accessed the database and executed the following queries:
Select * from controllermaster where ipaddr=''
Select * from machinedata(nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'
6. These queries revealed over 1500 pending commands, necessitating the removal of redundant data from the device. I executed the query:
Delete from machinedata(nolock) where controllerid='' and status='P'
7. With the machine data cleared, all commands were successfully processed by the device.
8. I initiated the user dump process on the device and allowed sufficient time for its completion.
9. Once the dump process concluded, I configured the device's card format, restoring its functionality to normal operation.

name: iApp
description_plain: VMS System is not working at Ankleshwar site.
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count: 
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Iapp not working in all over zydus
description_plain: Iapp software is not working in all over zydus locations and showing continuously loading on the page.
comments:
1. The client reported that the software is not functioning across all Zydus sites, continuously displaying a loading page when opened.
2. Upon investigation, I confirmed the software was indeed not functioning. I took the Zydus server to diagnose the actual issue.
3. Upon accessing the task manager, I observed that CPU utilization was exceeding 95%.
4. To assess CPU utilization processes, I executed the following query in the database:
Query :- SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING( st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
                                           ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
                                           ELSE statement_end_offset
                                           END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME (objectid , r.database_id ) as SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
order by Seconds desc
5. No high CPU processes were detected within the server.
6. Attempting to alleviate the issue, I tried to stop the SpectraWorker service and the IIS server. However, due to server hang issues, it took an extended duration to halt both processes.
7. After successfully stopping both processes, CPU usage decreased. However, upon restarting the processes, CPU usage spiked back to 95%.
8. I needed access to the database server (172.24.26.61) to pinpoint the actual issue. Unfortunately, due to restrictions from Zydus HO, access to the database server was unavailable.
9. After some time, the processes automatically normalized, and the software began functioning correctly again.

Select * from Location

Delete from Visitor where id='575821'
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: When save the visitor gate pass showing unique key constraint error on it.
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count: 
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

comments:

2. After discussing with the client, I learned that the IT person is unavailable today. Consequently, the client will call us tomorrow for the configuration process.
solution:
1. The client reported the need to configure a new canteen device recently purchased, which is still under warranty.
2. I initiated the process and guided them to input the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway of the device.
3. Next, I opened the bootloader application and configured the device parameters, such as the server IP, and updated the firmware of the canteen device.

6. After the dump process finished, I configured the card format in the device. However, upon attempting to print, a "printer disconnected" error appeared on the device.
7. I guided them to navigate to the network settings and disable Bluetooth printer settings. This action resolved the error.

name: iApp
description_plain: Duplicate -1 entries are showing in the VMS front desk option. please check this and solve the problem
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID.
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to May 6, 2024, and found more than 1000 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations.
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query:
Select * into Visitor_06052024 from Visitor
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs:
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='14' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query:
Delete from Visitor where id='575821'
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

description_plain: ZPL SEZ-2 sequencing number wrong showing in turnstile punching report. Just like . 1. Turnstile 2 out punch showing turnstile 3 2. Turnstile 3 out punch showing turnstile 2 3. Turnstile 5 in/out transection showing turnstile 6 4. Turnstile 6 in punch showing control panel 2 and out punch turnstile 7 5. Turnstile 7 in punch showing turnstile 7 out punch control panel 2 6. And turnstile 5 Name is missing from the system.
comments:
1. The client reported that the turnstile name is displaying incorrectly, and when employees punch on the device, the turnstile name is appearing differently.
2. Despite the client sharing a turnstile name list indicating proper device names, I requested them to please share the IP address along with the turnstile name. This will enable us to check the device configuration from our end as well.
solution:
1. The client reported that the turnstile data is displaying a mismatch. For instance, when an employee punches out on turnstile 2, the software reflects it as turnstile 3 out, which is incorrect.
2. I proceeded to open the software and systematically checked the configuration of each turnstile device, all of which appeared to be correct.
3. Upon further investigation, I accessed the transaction view to examine the data and discovered that all the face scribe devices were configured with two control panels.
4. As all the data was accurately displayed in the transactions view report, I promptly shared this information with the client.

delete FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='145371' AND attddate='2024/04/17' AND category = 'mispunch';
4. After successfully deleting the misspunch application, I reprocessed the attendance data, ensuring that the punches were now accurately reflected.

name: iApp
description_plain: Need to install biomini in security system.
comments:
1. The client needs to install the BioMini software in the security system for fingerprint scanning purposes. 
2. I have requested them to provide remote access so that I can install and configure the BioMini setup from my location. 
3. I created a OneDrive link for the BioMini setup and shared it with them. 
4. Following that, I installed the Spectra client service, but encountered an error indicating that the service was disabled. I informed the IT team to enable the service. 
5. Once the service was enabled, I proceeded to install the BioMini drivers and update the other files in the generated Spectra client folder, granting everyone rights to the folder. 
6. I installed the library files and initiated the Spectra client service. At this point, the BioMini scanning functionality is working correctly. I provided training on how to use the scanning feature to the users.
7. After installation is completed service is not start so i reinstall the service setup and paste all the files to the program files folder.
8. Now biomini is working properly.
solution:
1. The client needs to install the BioMini software in the security system for fingerprint scanning purposes. 
2. I have requested them to provide remote access so that I can install and configure the BioMini setup from my location. 
3. I created a OneDrive link for the BioMini setup and shared it with them. 
4. Following that, I installed the Spectra client service, but encountered an error indicating that the service was disabled. I informed the IT team to enable the service. 
5. Once the service was enabled, I proceeded to install the BioMini drivers and update the other files in the generated Spectra client folder, granting everyone rights to the folder. 
6. I installed the library files and initiated the Spectra client service. At this point, the BioMini scanning functionality is working correctly. I provided training on how to use the scanning feature to the users.
7. After installation is completed service is not start so i reinstall the service setup and paste all the files to the program files folder.
8. Now biomini is working properly.

description_plain: Kindly look into as from last 2 days attendance punching timing is not shown in Darwin.
comments:
1. Many attendance transactions were not appearing in the attendance spreadsheet, so I collaborated with Setul, sir, to address this issue. 
2. Despite restarting the Spectra worker service several times, no transactions appeared, and the pending data count exceeded 50,000+. 
3. Subsequently, we accessed the database server and executed the following queries: 
SELECT count(*) FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='P' AND Autoid<='45658217' --67389 
SELECT* FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='P' AND empid='10915' 
SELECT * FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='P' AND Autoid<='45658217' AND punchdatetime >='2024-05-09 00:00:01' --67389 
4. We discovered over 67,000 entries marked with an 'X' flag, prompting us to change the process flag to 'P' and restart the Spectra worker service. 
SELECT count(*) FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='X' 
SELECT * FROM AttdDetails(nolock) WHERE processflag='X' AND punchdatetime BETWEEN '2024-05-01 02:00:01' AND '2024-05-12 02:00:01'--67389 
--UPDATE AttdDetails SET processflag='P' WHERE processflag='X' AND punchdatetime BETWEEN '2024-05-01 02:00:01' AND '2024-05-12 02:00:01'--67389 
5. Following the update of the process flag, all data began downloading and eventually cleared after waiting for some time. 
6. Presently, the attendance data is displaying correctly.

comments:
1. bThe client has reported an urgent issue where the configured third-party export data in the access control system is not displaying. Immediate assistance is required.
2. Initially, the client attempted to join us via Google Meet to demonstrate the issue, but encountered permission issues. Consequently, they provided a Teams link for remote access.

4. To troubleshoot, I requested access to the SQL database and executed a query to export the data. The results revealed NULL values in both columns.
5. Upon inspecting the table structure, I noticed that no specific data types were assigned to the columns. I updated them to VARCHAR.
6. Subsequently, I reviewed the log file and identified a connection error.
7. I advised the client to save and reapply the export data configuration and then perform a new punch on the device to verify data transmission.
8. Despite the client's attempt, the issue persisted, with values still appearing as NULL. I requested them to provide us with the log file, export data configuration, table structure, and the iApp software version for further analysis.
9. This case requires escalation to the software development team for a comprehensive solution.

name: iApp
description_plain: As talked, I punched at turnstile at 10:58 (in punch), pls refer below SS wherein in punch at turnstile is not being seen. turnstile in punch time not showing of 08/05/24 - Emp. ID 133875 Pls check for missing data for miss punch application approval.
comments:
1. The client reported that the employee punches were not showing up. To investigate, I accessed the Zydus server and created a log file for the date of April 8th, 2024.
2. After importing the file into the log extractor, I extracted the data and filtered it by the employee card ID. Surprisingly, the employee punches were visible in the log file, contradicting their absence in the software.
3. To resolve the issue, it was necessary to recover the file in the services and restart the Spectra Worker service. However, due to insufficient admin rights, we were unable to restart the service from our end.
solution:
1. We've been granted admin rights by the Zydus headquarters team, enabling us to restart the Spectra worker service.
2. Using the log extractor application, I extracted the log file and identified an in-punch entry from the access device that wasn't reflected in the software transactions.
3. To address this, I created a recovery file for the 2c device in service and inserted the log details for the in-punch entry.
4. Following a restart of the Spectra worker process, the access punch is now visible in the software after a short period of time.

name: iApp
description_plain: As our recent discussion, it appears there's an issue with the report scheduler. Despite earlier assurances of the report's functionality, it seems that the scheduled reports are not being sent out as expected Could you please look into this matter and resolve by today ASAP.
comments:
1. The client reported that the report scheduler isn't functioning, and the recipient hasn't received the report via email.
2. After discussing with the client, I generated a new report scheduler to investigate the issue, but the email wasn't received.
3. I accessed the email notification menu in settings but didn't find any emails generated by the system for the report scheduler.
4. Subsequently, I attempted to access the Zydus server, but encountered issues with server access. I coordinated with the Zydus HO team and discovered that the password validity had expired.
5. The Zydus HO IT team renewed the password policy, restoring my access to the Zydus server database.
6. I executed the following query on the report scheduler table for the specific report ID, but unfortunately, no data was found:
Select * from reportschedulerheadernew(Nolock) where reportid='242'
solution:
1. I am collaborating on this case with Setul sir and have identified that the report scheduler is malfunctioning, resulting in reports not being generated on time.
2. In an attempt to rectify the issue, we created a new report scheduler named "test report," but unfortunately, it also failed to schedule on time.
3. To pinpoint the exact cause, we extracted the database and executed the following query.
SELECT  *   FROM ReportScheduleHeadernew WHERE Reportname='Month-wise More than 12 hours working'
SELECT * FROM Setup WHERE Category='ReportExecution'
SELECT  *   FROM ReportScheduleHeadernew WHERE id=388
SELECT  *   FROM ReportScheduleHeadernew  (nolock) r INNER JOIN reportdesignernew r1
ON r1.id=r.reportid WHERE Category='ARS'
WHERE r.Reportname='Month-wise More than 12 hours working' AND Name='test'
SELECT count(*)  FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-03-26' AND '2024-05-22'
SELECT IsDisable ,* FROM ReportScheduleHeaderNew (nolock) WHERE Reportname='Month-wise More than 12 hours working'
SELECT *FROM ReportScheduleHeadernew (nolock) WHERE Reportname='Month-wise More than 12 hours working'
SELECT *FROM ReportScheduleHeaderNew (nolock) WHERE ReportID='81'
SELECT * FROM [LOG] (nolock) WHERE Remarks='414';
SELECT * FROM [LOG] (nolock) WHERE Remarks='414';
SELECT * FROM [LOG] (nolock) WHERE Remarks='445';
SELECT * FROM [LOG] (nolock) WHERE Remarks='425';
SELECT *FROM ReportScheduleHeaderNew (nolock) WHERE  id='414'
SELECT TOP(1000) *  FROM EmailLog (nolock) WHERE subject LIKE '%Report%' AND sentdate >='2024-05-23 18:01:00'
--UPDATE ReportScheduleHeaderNew  SET IsDisable='Y'
UPDATE ReportScheduleHeadernew  SET IsDisable='N' WHERE  ID IN(
SELECT id FROM ReportScheduleHeadernew_23052024 WHERE IsDisable='N')
4. Our investigation revealed that this issue is a bug, prompting us to reach out to the product development team for assistance.
5. Upon consultation, the product development team provided us with a new DLL file to replace the existing one.
6. I proceeded to back up the old DLL file, replaced it with the new one, and restarted the Spectra worker process.
7. Subsequently, the report scheduler resumed functioning correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: When saving the visitor registration, an error is displayed indicating a unique key constraint violation.
comments:
Find the steps below: 
1. When we open the registration page and attempt to save the gate pass, we receive an error Unique key constraint. 
2. To check the visitor count mismatch issue, we take the Zydus server and open the SQL dbx. 
3. We execute the following query in the database: 
-- SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
-- SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 
4. We find that the visitor count sequence is mismatched, so we update the sequence with the following query: 
--UPDATE SEQUENCES SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 
5. Now that the sequence is updated, the VMS is working properly.
solution:
Find the steps below: 
1. When we open the registration page and attempt to save the gate pass, we receive an error Unique key constraint. 
2. To check the visitor count mismatch issue, we take the Zydus server and open the SQL dbx. 
3. We execute the following query in the database: 
-- SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
-- SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 
4. We find that the visitor count sequence is mismatched, so we update the sequence with the following query: 
--UPDATE SEQUENCES SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE'%visitor%' 
5. Now that the sequence is updated, the VMS is working properly.

ticket_title: Location transfer completed but data not showing
description_plain: For the employee id 146248 location transfer is perform from oncology to baddi location and command showing successfully completed but attendance data is not showing.
comments:
1. The client reported that the employee's transfer location has been completed and the policy has been assigned to them. However, the employee's location still shows the old location, and attendance data is not displaying.
2. Upon opening the location transfer menu, I found that the process is marked as completed. I then checked the employee master menu and noticed that the employee is still listed under the old location.
3. To address this issue, I deleted the location transfer performed by the user and reassigned the location transfer application for them. The process was completed successfully.
4. Despite these actions, the old location continued to display. I then accessed the server database and executed the following queries:
Select * from empmaster where code='146248'
Select * from allusers(nolock) where empcode='146248'
Select * from sechdulerprocess(nolock) where status='P'
5. It became apparent that all commands were stuck in a pending status and were not clearing. To resolve this, I restarted the Spectra worker service. After some time, all processes cleared.
6. Subsequently, the new location transfer began showing correctly in the employee master menu, and attendance data started displaying on the spreadsheet.
solution:
1. The client reported that the employee's transfer location has been completed and the policy has been assigned to them. However, the employee's location still shows the old location, and attendance data is not displaying.
2. Upon opening the location transfer menu, I found that the process is marked as completed. I then checked the employee master menu and noticed that the employee is still listed under the old location.
3. To address this issue, I deleted the location transfer performed by the user and reassigned the location transfer application for them. The process was completed successfully.
4. Despite these actions, the old location continued to display. I then accessed the server database and executed the following queries:
Select * from empmaster where code='146248'
Select * from allusers(nolock) where empcode='146248'
Select * from sechdulerprocess(nolock) where status='P'
5. It became apparent that all commands were stuck in a pending status and were not clearing. To resolve this, I restarted the Spectra worker service. After some time, all processes cleared.
6. Subsequently, the new location transfer began showing correctly in the employee master menu, and attendance data started displaying on the spreadsheet.

GO

description_plain: Unable to delete PL for employee
comments: As discussion with client they will arrange remote at 23/05/2024.
solution:
1)Client reported that an employee took PL leave for 10 days, which showed up in the attendance sheet, but the total count of PL remained unchanged. 
2)We took remote access from the client to investigate both the front-end and back-end systems. 
3)We observed that the employee had taken HPL and FPL leave, which were not deducted earlier. 
4)To resolve the issue, we ran the following query:
```
update may set leaveday=null where empid='EVA21083'
```
5)This deleted all incorrect entries, and we confirmed that the issue was resolved.

ticket_title: Location transfer completed but in employee master not updated
description_plain: We have complete Attendance transfer Process in I App but Location not updated After transfer process.
comments:
1. The client reported that despite completing the location transfer in the system, the old location is still displayed when accessing the employee master.
2. Upon opening the employee master, I observed that the employee was transferred to the Zydus Corporate Park location, yet the old location (SMD) was still showing.
3. I proceeded to extract the Zydus server database and executed the following query:
Select * from schdulerprocess where status='Pending'
4. After discovering over 6000 records displaying as pending, I intended to change the process flag and restart the service. Unfortunately, due to the unavailability of admin rights, I couldn't proceed with restarting the service. As a result, I'm awaiting a response from the Zydus HO team.
solution:
1. The client reported that the employee's transfer location has been completed and the policy has been assigned to them. However, the employee's location still shows the old location, and attendance data is not displaying. 
2. Upon opening the location transfer menu, I found that the process is marked as completed. I then checked the employee master menu and noticed that the employee is still listed under the old location. 
3. To address this issue, I deleted the location transfer performed by the user and reassigned the location transfer application for them. The process was completed successfully. 
4. Despite these actions, the old location continued to display. I then accessed the server database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='146512' 
Select * from allusers(nolock) where empcode='146512' 
Select * from sechdulerprocess(nolock) where status='P' 
5. It became apparent that all commands were stuck in a pending status and were not clearing. To resolve this, I restarted the Spectra worker service. After some time, all processes cleared. 
6. Subsequently, the new location transfer began showing correctly in the employee master menu, and attendance data started displaying on the spreadsheet.

description_plain: while updating the application, a Late early waiver error is shown and no policy is assigned to user

So, now we have removed the barrier of 3 applications and set it for 45 minutes, which states that users can apply 'n' applications for up to 45 minutes in a month.

name: iApp
description_plain: When open the frontdesk menu data its error showing that page unresponsive.
comments:
1. The client reported that when we open the front desk menu in the visitor page, it shows "loading" for some time, followed by a "waiting" error indicating the page is unresponsive.
2. Upon investigation, I discovered that the software was functioning slowly due to a large amount of visitor data, causing delays in page loading.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and observed high CPU consumption. To address this, I initially halted the Spectra worker service.
4. Subsequently, I stopped the IIS server and allowed some time for the CPU consumption to stabilize. Following this, I restarted the IIS server process and reactivated the Spectra worker service.
5. The CPU utilization has now returned to normal, and the software is operating smoothly.
solution:
1. The client reported that when we open the front desk menu in the visitor page, it shows "loading" for some time, followed by a "waiting" error indicating the page is unresponsive.
2. Upon investigation, I discovered that the software was functioning slowly due to a large amount of visitor data, causing delays in page loading.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and observed high CPU consumption. To address this, I initially halted the Spectra worker service.
4. Subsequently, I stopped the IIS server and allowed some time for the CPU consumption to stabilize. Following this, I restarted the IIS server process and reactivated the Spectra worker service.
5. The CPU utilization has now returned to normal, and the software is operating smoothly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Security Monitor Application Not Working
comments:
We took control of the user's system remotely and found that the user wanted to install a security monitor on the client system.

We ran the security monitor setup executable and entered all the SQL credentials to connect the application to the SQL server.

While troubleshooting, we discovered that the SQL connection was not established on the client system.

So, we asked the user to establish the proper ODBC connection on the client system and then connect to us.
solution:
To installed security monitor system we have perform below steps,
1.Installed Security Monitor Setup 
2.Provide full access rights to SM application Folder
3.Open SM Application and enter SQL Credential/Web.config
4.I App > Setting > User Configurations > Lookup Types > New (Create new look up type Location wise, named Security monitor)
5.I App > Base > Masters > Lookups > New (Create new look up named SM)
6.I App > Access Control > Device Management > Access Zone > New (Create new access zone for selected location)
7.I App > Access Control > Device Management > General Door Group > New(Create General door group for Outer circle or inner circle as per requirement)
8.I App > Access Control > Configurations > Muster Settings > New (Create a new muster setting for created general door groups)
9.I App > Base > Master > Employee > New (Created SM test employee for specific Security monitor access)
10.I App > Setting > User Administration > Roles > New > (Created new role which is having only security monitor rights)
11. I App > Setting > User Administration > Users > Add User Group > Select Security Monitor Role > Select Company > Select Location > Select Created Access Group > Save.
12.I App > Setting > User Administration > Users > Select User Group > Edit > Add user > Save.

description_plain: We have complete Attendance transfer Process in I App but Location not updated After transfer process.
comments:
1. Although the user has completed the location transfer process for the employee and assigned all policies, the employee still appears in the old location in the employee master.
2. Upon checking the employee master, I found that the location is still displaying as the old one. To resolve this issue, I accessed the Zydus server database.
3. I executed the following queries:
Select * from scheduledprocess where status='Pending'
Select * from scheduledprocess where status='Pending' and eventname='Employee added'
4. Analysis revealed numerous records, so I updated them using the following query to clear all pending events:
Update scheduledprocess SET status ='Xpending' where status='Pending' and eventname='Employee added'
5. After updating all records to 'X' flag, I restarted the Spectra worker service and waited. However, not all pending events were cleared.
6. To further investigate, I executed the query to check the available events:
Select DISTINCT Eventname From scheduledprocess 
7. I discovered a total of 16 events, including "Attendance Policy Changed," "Canteen ItemMaster Price Changed," and others.
8. I proceeded to update each event one by one, and after restarting the Spectra worker service, the location transfer process showed successful completion.

name: iApp
description_plain: When open the iapp software its showing license full in web link.
comments:
1. The client escalated that the software across all Zydus locations is not opening, displaying an error indicating that the license limit is full.
2. Upon discussion with the internal team, it was confirmed that the software was unable to open due to reaching the license limit.
3. I requested the user to provide us with some contract employees' details so that we could relieve them from the system, thereby decreasing the license count.
4. Consulting with Javed Sir from the development team, I executed the following query to relieve an employee from the system:
Select * from allusers where empcode='22DISHA00049'
5. Subsequently, I relieved each employee one by one, updating their relieve date and setting their active status to 'R'. Following this, I executed the query below to determine the number of users remaining within the license limit:
SELECT Count(*) as UsersCnt from (
                                  SELECT  A.ID AS UsersCnt from allusers A, UserMapping B where isnull(A.isinactive,'N') <> 'R' And A.LocationID = B.LocationID And A.ID = B.UserID
                                    and (ISNULL(AttendancePolicy,0) <> 0 or ISNULL(LeavePolicy,0) <> 0
                or ISNULL(OvertimePolicy,0) <> 0 or ISNULL(LateEarlyPolicy,0) <> 0
                or ISNULL(WeekOffPolicy,0) <> 0 or ISNULL(HolidayPolicy,0) <> 0
                or ISNULL(ShiftPattern,0) <> 0 or ISNULL(TourPolicy,0) <> 0
                or ISNULL(DeductionPolicy,0) <> 0)
                                    union
                                  SELECT  A.ID AS UsersCnt from allusers A, ARSUserAccess B where isnull(A.isinactive,'N') <> 'R' And A.LocationID = B.LocationID And A.ID = B.UserID and TzGrpid is not null
                                  union
                                  SELECT distinct(A.ID) AS UsersCnt from allusers A, UserGlobalAccess B where isnull(A.isinactive,'N') <> 'R' and B.category = 'A' And A.ID = B.EmpID and (b.tzgrpid <> '0' and b.tzgrpid <> '' and b.tzgrpid is not null)) a
6. Now, the count is reduced to 24000, and the software is functioning correctly.

2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to May 6, 2024, and found more than 1000 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_06052024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location 
Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='14' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

name: iApp
description_plain: This is for your information that 'Time and Attendance ' not open in Zydus Connect. Please do needful. Screen shot attached for your reference. Emp. Name: Vinod Kumar Emp.ID : 82237 Dept. : QA
comments:
1. The client reported that the iapp software is not functioning properly. Users attempting to log in are encountering the error message "User is not authenticated for this page."
2. I requested the client to kindly share the login ID and password so that I can investigate the issue further from my end.
3. The client provided us with the login credentials. However, upon attempting to log in, the password was incorrect. I have requested the correct password from them.
solution:
1. The client reported encountering an error when attempting to open the login ID. I received the login credentials from the user.
2. Upon investigating further, I found that upon opening the login, an error was indeed displayed. It became evident that an incorrect filter had been applied to it.
3. To address the issue, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries:
SELECT * FROM UserMaster(nolock) WHERE empid='145'
SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' and id='193'
4. Upon examination, it was confirmed that an incorrect filter had been applied. To rectify this, I proceeded to delete the filter using the following query:
DELETE FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' and id='193'
5. Following the removal of the filter, I reattempted to login to the login ID and confirmed that the login functionality was restored and working properly.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: They found the error: the door opening and closing is not working.
comments: when client reach to site then they connect
solution:
We conducted a remote session to understand the issue where, when a user punched on the device, the data showed as downloading, but the door did not unlock. We edited and saved the controller settings, and updated the firmware, but the issue was not resolved. We asked the client to check if the light on the lock was blinking. The client reported that it was not blinking.

The client also mentioned that when connected to another slot on the controller, the lock worked, but another lock was already connected to that slot. We consulted with the hardware team, who guided us to connect the lock to the NC1 slot instead of the NO1 slot. We made the changes and updated the gate type in > Master > Gate Setup > changing the gate type to "Fail Secure" instead of "Fail Safe." After these adjustments, the issue was resolved.

Additionally, there was another issue where data was not downloading when a user punched on the card reader. To resolve this, we dumped the PC data and reset the gate parameters to default. After this, the data started downloading correctly.

We conducted a remote session to understand the issue where, when a user punched on the device, the data showed as downloading, but the door did not unlock. We edited and saved the controller settings, and updated the firmware, but the issue was not resolved. We asked the client to check if the light on the lock was blinking. The client reported that it was not blinking.

The client also mentioned that when connected to another slot on the controller, the lock worked, but another lock was already connected to that slot. We consulted with the hardware team, who guided us to connect the lock to the NC1 slot instead of the NO1 slot. We made the changes and updated the gate type in > Master > Gate Setup > changing the gate type to "Fail Secure" instead of "Fail Safe." After these adjustments, the issue was resolved.

Additionally, there was another issue where data was not downloading when a user punched on the card reader. To resolve this, we dumped the PC data and reset the gate parameters to default. After this, the data started downloading correctly.

description_plain: Need guidance about leave policy and leave applicaiton
comments:
1. **Assigning Leave Policy:**
   - Define the types of leave (e.g., annual leave, sick leave, maternity leave, etc.).
   - Specify the eligibility criteria for each type of leave.
   - Establish the accrual method and the maximum leave balance.
   - Determine the procedure for applying for leave, including notice periods and documentation requirements.
   - Communicate the leave policy clearly to all employees through the employee handbook or company intranet.

2. **Applying for Leave:**
   - Employees should submit a leave application through the designated leave management system or form.
   - The application should include the type of leave, start date, end date, and reason for the leave.
   - The employee's manager or the HR department will review and approve or deny the leave application.
   - Employees will be notified of the approval or denial through the leave management system or via email.

3. **Canceling a Leave Application:**
   - If an employee needs to cancel an approved or pending leave application, they should submit a cancellation request through the leave management system or inform their manager/HR.
   - The request should include the details of the leave to be canceled and the reason for cancellation.
   - The manager or HR department will review and approve the cancellation request.
   - Employees will be notified of the cancellation approval, and the leave balance will be adjusted accordingly.

4. **Assigning Rights:**
   - Define the roles and permissions within the leave management system (e.g., employee, manager, HR administrator).
   - Assign rights based on the role, such as who can apply for leave, who can approve/deny leave, and who can cancel leave applications.
   - Ensure that the leave management system has a robust access control mechanism to manage these rights.
   - Regularly review and update user permissions to ensure they align with organizational changes and policies.

comments:

We further checked other reports and confirmed with Ketul Sir that there is no option in the software to export email IDs.

We advised the client that if they need the email IDs, they can run the following query in the NetXS database:

SELECT * FROM EMP
They can then copy the resulting table and paste it into Excel.

description_plain: Mobile ESS App not working and showing Server Error
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that employees were not able to access the Mobile ESS application.

During troubleshooting, we discovered that for any Mobile ESS application to work, the Mobile Application server should be accessible over the internet. Additionally, configurations like TLS (Transport Layer Security) 1.1 or 1.0 should be enabled on the application server.

While checking, we found that TLS was disabled on the application server, which was preventing employees from accessing the application. We asked the user to enable TLS, and after doing so, all employees are now able to access the ESS application.

description_plain: It has come to our attention that there might be a glitch in our system regarding shift changes and the subsequent approval of LCs. Specifically, we've noticed that when there is a shift change and an LC is approved afterward, the LC is not being deleted as expected. This issue requires urgent attention to ensure smooth operations.
comments:
1. We opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2021/11/17' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

ticket_title: Need guidance about how access control work in biot device
description_plain: Need guidance about how access control work in biot device
comments:
Connecting Two Devices to the Same Account:
Open the application.
Go to the "Devices" section.
Add the first device by entering its details and assigning it to the account.
Repeat the process to add the second device, ensuring both devices are assigned to the same account.
Verify that both devices appear under the same account in the "Devices" section.

Ensuring Client Access and Attendance Mode:
Ensure the client has access to the application with the necessary permissions to configure devices.
Guide the client to log in to the application.
Instruct the client to verify that both devices are listed and configured correctly in "Attendance Mode."
Ensure the client knows how to switch between devices if needed and that both devices are operational within the account.

Marking Punch with Access Control and Exit Switch:
Users should approach the device and use their credentials (e.g., fingerprint, card, PIN) to mark their punch.
The device will register the punch and update the attendance records in the application.
To exit, users can use the designated exit switch if available, which will also register the exit punch.
Ensure the client understands how to check and verify punches in the application, confirming that both access control and exit punches are accurately recorded.

ticket_title: Issue in the one employee Face Reader Problem
description_plain: Having Issue in the one employee Face Reader Problem at Mata Na Madh Site
comments:
We took a remote session of the user and found that employee code P002910783 was unable to punch on the face scribe device. While checking the employee master, we discovered that the user had added the same employee with a different employee code, and both employee statuses were set to "relieved." We asked the user which code they wanted to use, and we changed the status of employee P002910783 from "relieved" to "active."

We then found that employee P002910783 was not assigned any card, so we created a new card. Here are the steps we followed:

In the App, navigate to Master > Card Inventory > New.
Created a new card ID with P002910783 and saved it.
Assigned this card ID to the employee:
In the App, go to Employee Master > Search Employee P002910783 > Edit > User Identification > Add Card > Save.
After assigning the card, we provided access rights to this employee:

In the App, go to Attendance Module > Assignment > Assign Access.
Selected the employee, assigned access, and saved the changes.
We have now asked the user to punch and confirm since the employee is not available right now.
solution: During the remote session with the user, we observed that while they were punching on the device, some of the punch data was appearing in the attendance sheet while some wasn't. We conducted a live punch test and discovered that data was being registered under different Card IDs. Consequently, we proceeded to remove the old Card IDs from the face portal in List Management. As a result, all the user's punch data is now being recorded correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: GF-59 Microbiology Lab(QC) device is not working and showing inactive.
comments:
1. Upon receiving a report from the client regarding the microbiology device not functioning, I accessed the database menu and identified that the device was marked as inactive.
2. Subsequently, I accessed the Zydus server to check the device's IP address and discovered that it was not responding to pings from the server. I advised the client to contact their IT team as the IP appeared to be inactive.
3. Following up on the issue, I engaged in a conference call with the IT team, providing them with details about the IP address. Despite their efforts, the device remained disconnected.
4. Since the Biostamp 3S device lacks a screen or keypad for configuration, I suggested connecting it to a laptop.
5. To facilitate this, I provided the IT team with the bootloader application, enabling them to search for the device and access its parameters.
6. Despite several attempts, the device remained unresponsive when connected to the laptop, prompting the need for an onsite visit by a hardware specialist.
7. To address this, I coordinated with internal team members, Jatin and Mrigank, and scheduled a hardware visit for the following day to resolve the issue.
solution:
1. Upon receiving a report from the client regarding the microbiology device not functioning, I accessed the database menu and identified that the device was marked as inactive.
2. Subsequently, I accessed the Zydus server to check the device's IP address and discovered that it was not responding to pings from the server. I advised the client to contact their IT team as the IP appeared to be inactive.
3. Following up on the issue, I engaged in a conference call with the IT team, providing them with details about the IP address. Despite their efforts, the device remained disconnected.
4. Since the Biostamp 3S device lacks a screen or keypad for configuration, I suggested connecting it to a laptop.
5. To facilitate this, I provided the IT team with the bootloader application, enabling them to search for the device and access its parameters.
6. Despite several attempts, the device remained unresponsive when connected to the laptop, prompting the need for an onsite visit by a hardware specialist.
7. To address this, I coordinated with internal team members, Jatin and Mrigank, and scheduled a hardware visit for the following day to resolve the issue.

description_plain: Leave Summary report and found no records
comments: Client reported that they have issue in generating leave summary report , we checked in all ways but not able to do so ,we forward to testing team for further.
solution:
1. As discussed earlier , we need to update version of iapp.
2. Firstly we transfer new version of Iapp (version 57).
3. After that i went to drive c> program files(x86) > Spectra>Iapp and create new folder for backup of Iapp.
4. Then open old folder of Iapp and copy sevices and web to backup folder.
5. After that go to services and stop spectra worker services.
6. After that go to IIS manager and stop IIS .
7. After that in web folder except this 4 files delete all the files ( 1. Spectrabase  , 2. web.config  , 3. appsetting.json , 4. custom report )
8. After that open new version files, go to services , copy all the files and paste in drive c> program files(x86) > Spectra>Iapp > services .
9. After that open new version files, go to pages , copy all the files and paste in drive c> program files(x86) > Spectra>Iapp > web .
10. After that go to IIS manager , start the service.
11. After that go to services , and start spectra worker services.
12. After some time open Iapp and reported issue has been resolved.

name: NetXsControl Ent.

comments: User will provide remote once their IT person is available.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that they were unable to generate any reports in the NetXsControl software. Upon further investigation, we found that employees were regularly punching in, but when checking in the Controller utility Get Status, we observed that the user had over 20 devices, and in all of them, transaction data was pending for download. Consequently, we synchronized the synchronizer and opened the Net Xs Control Downloading Exe, then selected all the controllers and initiated the downloading process.
Now we generated the reports and all report generated successfully.

3.Unselect default parameter
4.select emergency module.
5.Set time for 15 second for all the switch on controller.

3.I App > Access Control > Device Management > Select Device > Edit > Changed all four EDR names in GPI > Save 
4..I App > Access Control > Door Action > Select Controller > INPUT > Add all four doors name input > Save

8. I factory reset the device and start the user dump process on it.
9. Wait for some time to complete the user dump process and after completed the process is set the card format of the device and now device is working fine.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Entire Organization attendance not showing
comments:
During a remote session with the user, we encountered an issue where the user couldn't access attendance data in the ARS Win spreadsheet. After investigation, we discovered that transactions were pending on the devices, and the user was on a client system without the necessary downloading executable.

To address this, we accessed the server remotely and attempted to open the downloading executable, but encountered an OCX error. We resolved this by replacing all OCX files on the server system and registering them. Subsequently, we opened the downloading executable, and all data was displayed correctly.
solution:
During a remote session with the user, we encountered an issue where the user couldn't access attendance data in the ARS Win spreadsheet. After investigation, we discovered that transactions were pending on the devices, and the user was on a client system without the necessary downloading executable.

To address this, we accessed the server remotely and attempted to open the downloading executable, but encountered an OCX error. We resolved this by replacing all OCX files on the server system and registering them. Subsequently, we opened the downloading executable, and all data was displayed correctly.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: ARSWIN net pro re-installation
comments:
Following the client's reinstallation of ARSWIN Net Pro, we took remote access to their system to assist with the process. Upon installation and starting the software, we discovered that no data was available, despite a backup being present on the system.

Further investigation revealed that the software was referencing the virtual database for data. To resolve this issue, we transferred all the data into the virtual database, which allowed the software to run correctly.
solution:

Further investigation revealed that the software was referencing the virtual database for data. To resolve this issue, we transferred all the data into the virtual database, which allowed the software to run correctly.

 7. Attendance Records Checking Instructions: Instruct the client on how to access and review attendance records through the system interface. This allows for easy monitoring of employee attendance and punctuality. 

8. Adding Holiday Schedules to the System: To enhance system functionality, you can add holiday schedules to ensure accurate attendance tracking. This involves inputting dates and details of holidays when regular work schedules are altered. description_plain: Face Punching Machine Sync issue (Date & Time)
comments:
Client reported they have issue in one device date & time sync.
I checked issue and found that in that device there are pending commands which is need to delete in database.
So we run quary in database
""
delete from MachineData where ControllerID='4' and status='P'   
""
After that device was in processing so they will check and update .
solution:
After deleting transactions from the server, we checked and found that there are still new pending transactions. 
After deleting these transactions, I stopped the Spectra work service and renamed the log folder in services. 
After that, I ran two queries, line by line:
"
Truncate table downloaddocument.
Delete from deviceutilitystatus.
"
After that, I started the Spectra worker service and the issue was resolved.

comments: Client will connect on Monday.

1.Checked if the employees' access group included DC5 CBRL Room.
2.Examined any exception rules to see if any were created.
3.Reviewed the machine data from SQL.
4.Analyzed the log files.
5.Filtered user logs using device code 00401.

We determined that some users had swapped devices and altered the device's IP and MAC addresses, leading to access discrepancies. To address this, we guided the user through the following steps:

1.Factory reset the device.
2.Edit and save the device settings.
3.Edit and save the access group to which the device belongs.
4.Provided access assignments.
5.Cross-checked the Door Access Map Report to ensure accuracy.

description_plain: Looking at a possible enhancement. Currently, the system option of resending activation code does not work as the code is already used up. If the reactivation option can work , the email option would still be preferred, Lots of BLE tags are wasted when someone leaves the company.
comments:
As per the issue reported, we understood that you have query for re-using BLE tags for relieved employees in the iApp.

We would like to clarify, if BLE tag is assigned to any employee and he gets relived, the tag will be surrender and not be re-used.  However another tag will be available in the system to assign another employee.

Suppose a client initially has 100 BLE tags, out of which 50 are in use. If 5 employees are relieved from their positions and their tags are surrendered, these specific tags will not be reused. Instead, an additional 5 tags will be added to the system, ensuring that the total count of tags remains at 100.

Let us know if any clarity require.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: NETXs database size is more than 16 GB . Want to reduce the database size as 16 GB database size cannot be copy by client as per IT TEAM policy size limit.
comments: We connect with client they unable to provide remote due to some network issue on there site so we re-schedule session for tomorrow
solution:
We conducted a remote session to understand the client's requirement regarding the backup of the NetXS database. Initially, we observed that the backup size of the NetXS database was 18 GB, while the database size shown in its properties was only 2 GB. We took a backup and found that the backup size was indeed 18 GB.

Upon further investigation, we checked the data MDF file for the database, which was 2 GB. We then performed a backup using a backup query and verified that the size of that backup was 2 GB.

Next, we reviewed the backup configuration in SQL Server, reset it, and set a new path for the backup, removing the old one. After taking another backup, we confirmed that its size was 2 GB. Following these troubleshooting steps, the issue was resolved.

ticket_title: New Joining Employees Face Did Not Capture In iApp
description_plain: New Joining Employees Face Did Not Capture In iApp
comments:
During a remote session with the user, we discovered that newly joined employees were unable to punch on two Face Scribe devices. While troubleshooting, we noticed that when we edited and saved the device, the command remained pending. Similarly, when we assigned access to employees, the command also remained pending.
To address this, we accessed the SQL server remotely and executed the following query to clear pending commands:
select * from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='p'
delete from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='p'
After executing the query, we provided access to the employee, and they were subsequently able to punch on the device.

You'll need to provide essential details such as your company name, address, and contact number and other needed information. Set up a secure password to ensure the safety of your account. it can be reset later on using OTP.

 4. Device Configuration and Policy Setup: Personalize the device by assigning it a distinct name and configuring any necessary policies like attendance, work hours, leave, device setup . This step ensures that the device operates according to your specific requirements and security measures.

 7. Attendance Records Checking Instructions: Instruct the client on how to access and review attendance records through the system interface. This allows for easy monitoring of employee attendance and punctuality. 

8. Adding Holiday Schedules to the System: To enhance system functionality, you can add holiday schedules to ensure accurate attendance tracking. This involves inputting dates and details of holidays when regular work schedules are altered. This feature enables the system to accommodate deviations from standard working hours and ensures accurate record-keeping.

9. Tour policies Guidance Process: Client have users to apply for particularly this then they are configuring upon understanding and explanation given to them.

 By following these comprehensive steps, you can successfully set up your new device, customize it to meet your needs, and seamlessly integrate it into your operational processes.

4.Select "Manage Subscription." 
5.Choose the desired plan, enabling and disabling features as needed. 
6.Complete the payment for the selected plan.

description_plain: unistamp 2c pin access
comments: we connect with client they currently leaving the office
solution: We conducted a remote session because the client wanted to start using card+finger on the UniSteam2C and face+card on the Face Scribe device. We tried to set it up, but it failed. So, we updated the firmware of the QuirdxS2C controller and the UniSteam2C device, and then tried to set card+finger on the UniSteam2C and face+card on the Face Scribe. After this, the UniSteam2C worked properly, but when the user punched the card on the Face Scribe device, they got an error (card unregistered). To resolve this, we set the parameter in the Face Scribe portal, set the card format on the controller, and dumped the user data. After this, the issue was resolved.

solution:

description_plain: We are facing a problem with communication software, causing IP Conflict we want to change a IP address for device.
comments:
During the remote session with the user, we discovered that one device was not coming online in the communication software, despite successful pinging. We advised the user to switch off the device to check for any conflicts with the ping, and indeed, we found that there was a ping conflict.

solution:
Your reported point is not an issue.

Its our default functionality that when ever you do Location Transfer of an employee in any module (Access , Attendance and  Canteen) from any form (Transfer location page , Import Data , Integration) It will just initiate the Location transfer of the employee with "Pending" status. Then you need to manually Edit the Employee and assign the required Policies and  Access Groups and Click on Save, then only Location transfer process gets completed with status as "Completed".

Conclusion: There is no other way to complete the Location Transfer process other than manually doing Edit and Save.

5.Paste Communication application folder backup on new server system.
6.Create a new path file according to new SQL credential.
7.Change IP address of two face scribe devices.

9.Added both devices on communication soft.
10.Assign access to all the employees on new server system.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
ticket_title: Netxs not opening in my PC
description_plain: Netxs not opening in my PC
comments: Sql backup will be restore by them side . after that we will reinstall Netxs.
solution:
1. The client reported the need to reinstall NetXS Control and establish an ODBC connection.

2. I proceeded to send the setup to the client's system.

3. The setup was installed accordingly.

4. On the server system, navigate to the NetXS Control directory and proceed to rename both the path and database.

5. Create a new path using the server's IP address.

6. Open the path in Notepad, copy the code, and paste it into the HEX to string converter. Then, copy the resulting string.

7. Attempting to open NetXS Control after modifying the path and database name resulted in the software failing to launch.

8. To address this, I copied the NetXS Control folder from the server's C drive and pasted it into the client system's Program Files directory.

9. Additionally, to resolve other errors, I transferred the VC library folder to the client system.

10. Subsequently, I installed the VC libraries one by one, which successfully allowed the software to open.

11. Finally, I registered `stxscontrol.dll`.

description_plain: Team, Few of our access control doors are unlocked. We tried all possible solutions including power recycle, restarting panels at regular intervals, and locking – unlocking from NetXs. However, the doors are open and are not functioning. Attached along is the previous communication that was for the same door. Request to look into this ASAP. Stay Safe!
comments: Given number in CRM not correct.
solution:
ChatGPT
We called the user and learned that they have two magnetic doors, both of which remain open at all times and do not close properly. To better understand the issue, we requested them to send videos, which are attached below.

After our hardware team examined both videos, they determined that in one device, the magnet light continuously blinks as expected. When the user presses it, the blinking stops briefly, indicating that the magnet lock is functioning correctly, and the issue lies with the door alignment. Therefore, we have advised the user to address this alignment problem.

In the second door, the magnet door light sometimes blinks and sometimes stops blinking. Therefore, we have instructed the user to check the power supply.

Since both issues stem from the user's side, we are closing this ticket.

name: iApp
description_plain: Live transaction not showing
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the client. The client reported that the transaction is not showing in the downloading and transaction view. We checked whether the device was on or off and found that all devices were off.

We then pinged all the devices, which responded successfully. Upon further inspection, we found that the devices were in bootloader mode. Additionally, we discovered that the Spectra worker process was off. We started the Spectra worker process, and after this, the devices came online and data began showing in the downloading view.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the client. The client reported that the transaction is not showing in the downloading and transaction view. We checked whether the device was on or off and found that all devices were off.

We then pinged all the devices, which responded successfully. Upon further inspection, we found that the devices were in bootloader mode. Additionally, we discovered that the Spectra worker process was off. We started the Spectra worker process, and after this, the devices came online and data began showing in the downloading view.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: Transaction Error
comments:
During a remote session, the client reported that transactions were not showing in the software. Upon investigation, we found that the downloading process had not started. We attempted to initiate the download, but it stopped almost immediately.

We then updated the software and tried again, but the issue persisted. After discussing with Mr. Jignes, he advised that the issue was likely due to a full database. Following his guidance, we resolved the issue by increasing the database size:

>Right-click on the Netxs database.
>Select 'Properties'.
>Go to the 'General' tab.
>Click on the three dots next to 'Database Size'.
>Set the database size to 'Unlimited'.
After performing these steps, the issue was resolved

description_plain: ARS Win Net installation on client system.
comments: We took a client remote session and performed the following steps to install ARS Win: 1. We copied the ARS Win-Net [5.0.0.15] Setup and pasted it on the client system. 2. We then took a remote session of the server system from the client end where ARS Win was already installed. 3. We copied the ARS Win Application folder from the server system and pasted it on the client system. 4. We ran the ARS Win-Net [5.0.0.15] Setup and installed it on the client system. 5. We then copied the ARS Win Application folder from the server and went to the file location of the newly installed ARS Win software. 6. We also installed vc2008redist_x86, vc2008redist_x64, vcredist_x86, and vcredist_x64. ARS Win Software was successfully installed on the client System.

ticket_title: Recurring Issue with Biometric Attendance System
description_plain: Dear Spectra Support Team,I hope this message finds you well.
