Please ensure that there are no further disruptions in our biometric attendance system. The reliability of this system is crucial for maintaining accurate employee attendance records and ensuring timely salary disbursements.Additionally, we request that you provide an option for a data view-only security user for easier management. Currently, the sub-admin role has full access and can alter data, which is not ideal for our needs. A data view-only user would allow us to manage the system more securely and efficiently.I trust you will understand the urgency and gravity of this situation and will address it promptly. name: iApp
description_plain: I need your help as my laptop is not getting fingerprint from biomini so please help in urgently
comments:
1. Before providing me remote access, please go to the Services and check if the Spectra Client Service is running or stopped. If it is showing as stopped, then start the service.
2. If the service is running and the Biomini is still not working, then please arrange remote access so I can check it from here as well.
solution:
1. Client reported that he need to install biomini in two system for finger taking process.
2. I request them to please give me the remote access so i can able to install biomini setup and after some time client give me teams link and i connect to the link but biomini setup is not available.
3. I create the one drive link for the biomini setup and IT team download the setup and after that i started the installation process.
4. When i install the spectra client service error showing the policy is disable so i request them to please enable the policy so i can able to install the spectra client service.
5. After some time IT team enable the policy and after that i install spectra client service and biomini drivers and completed whole the installation of biomini so now finger access is working fine, i also give them steps about how to install biomini as per below :-
6. First, install the Spectra Client service mentioned below using administrator credentials. Proceed with installation directly upon clicking.
7. Next, install the Suprema BioMini Plus2 driver on the system. Check in the Control Panel to ensure both the Spectra Client service and Suprema drivers are visible.
8. Navigate to the Spectra Client folder, copy all files, and paste them into the following path:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Spectra\Spectra Client\. 
Grant full administrator rights (Everyone) to the Spectra Client folder after pasting.
9. Proceed to the Suprema BioMini Plus 2 folder. Copy the files as indicated below and paste them into the following paths:
 Paste into: C:\Windows\System32\
 Paste into: C:\Windows\sysWOW64\
10. Install the x64 and x86 library files on the system as specified.
11. Access the services and start the Spectra Client service. Once the service is running, the BioMini installation is complete. 
Proceed to the iApp login and Employee Master. Click "Take Finger," then place the finger on the device when the red light blinks to register it on the software.

description_plain: Please find punching Device details and add in i-app. Device Name: FF Packing Area IP: 172.24.226.210 Subnet: 255.255.255.0 Gateway: 172.24.226.1
comments: The client needs to add a new device, but we need to check the device warranty from here first.
solution:
1. The client provided us with the IP address they wanted to configure for the device, so I checked the Zydus server to verify the device IP connection.
2. I pinged the server and found that the device IP was responding properly, but the device was not appearing in the bootloader application. I discussed this with the client and requested that they power off the device.
3. After powering off the device, I pinged the server again and discovered that the device IP was still responding, indicating an IP conflict.
4. I discussed the issue with the IT team, who advised us to resolve the IP conflict. They provided us with a new IP address to assign to the device.
5. After updating the device with the new IP address, the device now appears as active on the server and is visible in the bootloader application.
6. I configured the device parameters and updated its firmware.
7. I then opened the software, added the new device, set the device parameters, and confirmed that commands were being sent successfully.
8. I created a new card format for the device and applied it.
9. Finally, I went to the attendance settings page, added the device to the attendance settings, and disabled the freescan mode from the device parameters.

name: iApp
description_plain: I wanted to bring to your attention that a biometric access control device has been installed in the GF-206 (Quarantine - IV). Could you please confirm if the device is properly mapped with the software? 172.31.16.230 GF-206 (Quarantine - IV)
comments:
1. The client reported that the device is not showing in the software. Please confirm if this device is configured in the iApp software.
2. I checked from here and found that the device is not configured in the software, so I shared this information.
solution:
1. Coordinate with the IT team and instruct them to insert the IP address, subnet mask, and gateway. Afterward, I checked the IP address on the server, and it displayed as active perfectly.
2. I opened the bootloader application, added the new device, entered the device parameters, but encountered an issue where the command did not proceed and remained pending. Upon further inspection in the bootloader application, I identified that the device firmware was incorrect. I proceeded to update the firmware of the device.
3. Following the firmware update, commands in the software were successfully executed. I configured the card format and performed a factory reset of the device using device operations.
4. Accessing the access groups, I added the device to all quarantine area access groups as per the client's requirements.
5. I initiated the user dump process and allowed sufficient time for it to complete.
6. After the user dump process finished, the device began functioning correctly.

name: iApp
description_plain: On date 29.05.2024 out punch record is not found of below Employee, kindly check. Emp id :61550
comments: Service start stop rights not available.
solution:
1. The client reported that the out punch for attendance is not displaying in the attendance sheet.
2. I accessed the miscellaneous menu to review the device transactions and found only one attendance punch recorded on 29/05/2024.
3. Next, I checked the device connectivity in the database menu and confirmed that the device is active and functioning correctly.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and searched for all log data files for that particular day. I copied all the files, created a new log folder, and extracted the files using a log extractor.
5. I filtered the log files by card ID and identified the attendance punch record for that day. I copied this file, created a new recovery file in services, and restarted the Spectra worker service.
6. After completing the restart, the file was successfully read, and the attendance data now appears correctly in the spreadsheet.

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Error found in ARSWin-net
comments:
1. The client reported an error found in ARSWin-net.
2. So, I checked the issue and found that after selecting all readers in the reader utility, when attempting to check the status, nothing was displayed.
3. Upon investigating further, we remotely accessed the server, navigated to C:\Windows\SysWOW64, and copied Netserver.dll.
4. We then pasted it into the client's system.
5. Next, we opened the command prompt, navigated to SysWOW64, and registered the DLL using the following command:
   "regsvr32.exe Netserver.dll"
6. Subsequently, the reported issue was resolved.

SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='145371' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='18696' AND attddate='2024/04/17' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
delete FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='145371' AND attddate='2024/04/17' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
4. After successfully deleting the misspunch application, I reprocessed the attendance data, ensuring that the punches were now accurately reflected.

With their confirmation, we updated to the new version of the I App, and after checking the scheduled reports, they are now working as expected.

name: iApp
description_plain: Dear Team, We are installed Bioscribe 3S device in freshworks site for access control and attendance system. Recently one Bioscribe 3S device showing some error code so we replaced that faulty device by new Bioscribe 3s device. But that new device also showing error of "Invalid config". Kindly find the attached video for your reference and do the needful. --
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the client, who reported that when attempting to dump the database onto the device, it hangs at 1%. Initially, we deleted the pending commands from the machine's data and tried to dump the users, but encountered another hang at 1%. The issue seems to be with the device having IP 192.168.151.168, where there is a configuration in the shared door. On this device, the dumping process is successful.

Subsequently, we performed a factory reset on the device and attempted to dump the data again, but the device went offline. Despite several attempts to restart it, we failed to bring it online. We then checked the bootloader and configured it, resulting in a restart. However, when we tried to dump the data, it again hung at 1%.

At this point, we connected with Prakash Sir, who advised us to delete only the last pending  command after successful  command after which we proceeded accordingly. Despite this action, the data dump now hangs at 7%. We then performed another factory reset on the device and configured it through the bootloader, achieving a successful 100% command execution.

However, the shared device (192.168.151.168) is now showing "user not found" after the factory reset. As a workaround, we dumped the data onto the shared device (192.168.151.169), which synced 100%. Unfortunately, the device at 192.168.151.168 is still hanging at 1% during the data dump process.
solution: We sent multiple RMAs but have not received any response. So, we called the client, and they said they will send the devices to Spectra when they have collected 7 to 8 devices from the client site.

description_plain: As discussed with Mr. Nilay patel pls confirm your suitable time before 02:00 P.M. for Bio-mini Installation process.
comments:
I am training the IT team on the installation steps for the BioMini configuration.
1. First, install the Spectra Client service mentioned below using administrator credentials. Proceed with installation directly upon clicking.   
2. Next, install the Suprema BioMini Plus2 driver on the system. Check in the Control Panel to ensure both the Spectra Client service and Suprema drivers are visible.   
3. Navigate to the Spectra Client folder, copy all files, and paste them into the following path:
   C:\Program Files (x86)\Spectra\Spectra Client\. Grant full administrator rights (Everyone) to the Spectra Client folder after pasting.   
4. Proceed to the Suprema BioMini Plus 2 folder. Copy the files as indicated below and paste them into the following paths:
   Paste into: C:\Windows\System32\
   Paste into: C:\Windows\sysWOW64\
5. Install the x64 and x86 library files on the system as specified.
6. Access the services and start the Spectra Client service. Once the service is running, the BioMini installation is complete. Proceed to the iApp login and Employee Master. Click "Take Finger," then place the finger on the device when the red light blinks to register it on the software.

description_plain: We need immediate support for ZAHIL’s canteen machine as the existing machine was not working hence we have installed new machine. Kindly arrange to configure the data in the said machine.
comments:
1. The client needs to replace the canteen device because the old one is not working.
2. I checked with the AMC team and found that client hardware support is not covered under AMC. Therefore, I transferred the call to the AMC team for further processing.
solution:
1. The client reported that the old canteen device is not working, so we need to replace it with the new BioScribe 3S device.

4. I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and configured the device parameters within it.
5. Following this, I opened the software, removed the old device from the system, and added the new device with its configured parameters.
6. Lastly, I performed a factory reset on the device and initiated the user dump process.

description_plain: Application not working
comments:
During the remote session, we found that the "Client Report Transactions" were not displaying correctly. Upon investigation, we discovered that the downloading and synchronization were turned off. We attempted to start these processes without success. To address this, we updated the software with the necessary executable files (exe) and dynamic-link libraries (dll). After this update, the downloading issue was resolved.

However, we encountered another issue: the Commsoft device was not online. Upon reviewing the webpage for the Face Scribe device, we identified an incorrect server IP address in the configuration. We corrected this error and confirmed that the device is now online, with data successfully coming through during the Commsoft download process

name: iApp
description_plain: Attendance Error
comments: AMC is not done.
solution:
1. Client reported that all of their devices are showing offline in iApp.
   
2. I took remote access and first checked the ping of all 22 devices; the ping responses were correct.

3. Next, I individually checked each device in bootloader mode. One device had incorrect details, so I corrected them. However, this device still showed offline.

4. I restarted the Spectra worker process, but the issue persisted.

5. I then stopped the Spectra worker process and IIS. Afterward, I navigated to the iApp location, copied the Spectra database, and pasted it into the web directory.

6. I proceeded to start IIS again and then started the Spectra worker process.

7. After verifying, all devices showed online and transactions began downloading one by one.

8. The reported issue has been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: In unit 2 attendance devices finger not found error showing. please help
comments:
1. The client reported that a "finger not found" error is appearing for all employees on 2 attendance devices.
2. Upon investigation, I confirmed that both access and fingerprints are registered on the devices for all employees.
3. Upon accessing the database menu in the software, I identified two devices, fp1000 and bioscribe2c-1m, with a finger capacity limit of 1900. Currently, the devices are showing 1910 fingerprints, indicating that the finger capacity has reached its maximum, causing the "finger not found" error.
4. I advised the client to remove access for unwanted employees from both the global and local databases to free up space and resolve the issue.

description_plain: Over the past 5-6 days, we have observed significant performance degradation in the iAPP without any identifiable cause from our end. As we operate across 42 locations where the application is used 24/7, this slowdown is severely impacting our operations. We urgently request your immediate attention to investigate this matter thoroughly and provide a permanent solution. It is crucial that we understand the reasons behind the sluggish performance or any underlying issues affecting the application. Please prioritize this issue and provide us with a detailed analysis at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your prompt action on this critical matter.
comments:
1. The client reported that the I-App software has been running slowly throughout the day.
2. Upon checking from our end, I confirmed that the software is indeed running slow and continuously loading on the web page.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and observed that the CPU usage was high. To address this, I opened the database and executed the following query:
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu,
          s.login_name,
          DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, GETDATE()) AS Seconds,
          s.session_id AS SessionID,
          blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
          SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1,
                             ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
                             ELSE statement_end_offset
                             END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
          OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC
4. Based on the results, it was evident that CPU consumption was spiking and occasionally causing the system to hang. I proceeded to terminate the unwanted session IDs that were consuming excessive resources.
5. Despite multiple attempts to optimize performance, the software continued to experience issues. Therefore, I escalated the matter to the IT team responsible for the database server and requested administrative rights to restart the SQL server.
6. After obtaining the necessary administrative rights, I restarted the SQL server. Subsequently, the CPU usage returned to normal levels, and the I-App software began functioning properly again.

After updated the core and ram recently server working is normal

Initiate Remote Connection: Use a remote desktop tool to connect to the old system where the `netXs` database is currently running. Ensure you have the necessary permissions and credentials to access this system. 2. Verify Database Version: On the old system, verify the SQL Server version to confirm it supports the `netXs` database version 904. Step 2: Backup the Database from the Old System 1. Open SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS): Launch SSMS on the old system and connect to the SQL Server instance hosting the `netXs` database. 2. Locate the Database: In the Object Explorer, navigate to the `Databases` node and locate the `netXs` database. 3. Backup the Database: - Right-click on the `netXs` database. - Select `Tasks` > `Back Up...`. - In the Backup Database window, configure the backup settings: - Set the `Backup type` to `Full`. - Specify the backup destination (e.g., a file on the disk). - Click `OK` to start the backup process. 4. Verify Backup Completion: Ensure the backup completes successfully and the backup file is stored in the specified location. Step 3: Transfer the Backup to the New System 1. Copy Backup File: Transfer the backup file from the old system to the new system. You can use a secure file transfer method such as FTP, SCP, or a shared network drive. 2. Verify Integrity: Ensure the backup file is intact and has been copied completely to the new system. Step 4: Connect to the Database Engine on the New System 1. Launch SSMS on the New System: Open SQL Server Management Studio on the new system. 2. Connect to SQL Server: Connect to the SQL Server instance on the new system where you intend to restore the `netXs` database. Step 5: Restore the Database on the New System 1. Restore Database: - In SSMS, right-click on the `Databases` node. - Select `Restore Database...`. - In the Restore Database window, select `Device` and browse to locate the backup file transferred from the old system. - Configure the restore options and specify the destination database name as `netXs`. - Click `OK` to start the restore process. 2. Verify Restoration: Ensure the database restoration completes successfully without any errors. Step 6: Run `netXs` Setup and Install Software 1. Run Setup: Locate the `netXs` setup file on the new system and run the installer. 2. description_plain: Dear Sir,As per our telephonic discussion, there are still some issues related to the software.The issues are highlighted1. Attendance Report - Not getting visible (PDF Format)2. Sometimes two card ID are shown for some employee while punching but we cannot see in the softwarePlease resolve this issue at the earliest.Thanks and regards-- Quality Heightcon Pvt.Ltd. 612 Tower A, Kohinoor City Mall Kohinoor City, Kirol RoadOff LBS Road, Kurla (W), Mumbai 400 070. Phone : 41546000 Mail : admin@qhpl.inVisit : www.qhpl.in
comments: Client will provide remote at their convenience.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that across all 15 locations, employees were experiencing an issue where despite being provided with new card IDs and having their old card IDs removed, the devices were still showing the old card IDs when employees punched in. Additionally, the transaction records were only displaying the old card IDs without showing the employee names.

To address this issue, we identified that there were likely pending commands in the system preventing the update of the new card IDs. Therefore, we performed the following steps to rectify the issue:

Here's the corrected version of your text:

1. In I App > Base > Master > Card Inventory, I checked whether the old card ID was still active.
2. In I App > Base > Master > Employee > Edit, I verified whether the old card ID was still assigned.
   After checking these two things, we performed a user dump process to clear any pending commands that might have been preventing the new card ID from updating in the system.

3. In I App > Attendance Management > Device Management > Database > Sync > User, we synced the user data.
   However, after performing these steps, we discovered that all employee fingerprint data had been removed, preventing them from punching in and showing an error message, "Please try again."

4. To resolve this, we assigned access to all employees:
   I App > Attendance Management > Assignment > Select employees > Assign local Access > Save.

5. During this process, we encountered continuous failures in finger command assignments, where finger commands were not reflecting in the device.

6. For testing purposes, we asked the user to re-register one employee's finger. After registration, the employee was able to punch in, and the new card ID appeared in transactions. However, the user data for finger data did not dump.

7. Subsequently, we used open SQL and executed the following query to delete pending commands:
   ```
   select * from controllermaster;
   select * from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='p';
   delete from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='p';
   ```

8. Despite executing these steps, the finger command still did not reflect in the system.

9. We then updated the latest firmware on all devices (BSC_IAPP_2C_V).

10. Additionally, we updated the I App version from 4.0.1.56 to 4.0.1.59.

11. In I App > Settings > Application Settings > General Setup, we changed the finger template from "ISO19794-2 format" to "Proprietary Format."

12. We performed a factory reset on the device:
    I App > Attendance Management > Device Management > Operation > Factory Reset.

13. Afterward, we reassigned access to all employees:
    I App > Attendance Management > Assignment > Select employees > Assign local Access > Save.

14. We then dumped the user data again in the machine.

Now, all user fingerprint data is being successfully recorded, and employees are able to punch in.

description_plain: Re-installation --Ludhiana
comments:
Steps to Resolve the SQL Server Version Compatibility Issue

Step 1: Take Remote Access of the Old System
1. Initiate Remote Connection: Use a remote desktop tool to connect to the old system where the `netXs` database is currently running. Ensure you have the necessary permissions and credentials to access this system.
2. Verify Database Version: On the old system, verify the SQL Server version to confirm it supports the `netXs` database version 904.

 Step 2: Backup the Database from the Old System
1. Open SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS): Launch SSMS on the old system and connect to the SQL Server instance hosting the `netXs` database.
2. Locate the Database: In the Object Explorer, navigate to the `Databases` node and locate the `netXs` database.
3. Backup the Database:
   - Right-click on the `netXs` database.
   - Select `Tasks` > `Back Up...`.
   - In the Backup Database window, configure the backup settings:
     - Set the `Backup type` to `Full`.
     - Specify the backup destination (e.g., a file on the disk).
   - Click `OK` to start the backup process.
4. Verify Backup Completion: Ensure the backup completes successfully and the backup file is stored in the specified location.
Step 3: Transfer the Backup to the New System
1. Copy Backup File: Transfer the backup file from the old system to the new system. You can use a secure file transfer method such as FTP, SCP, or a shared network drive.
2. Verify Integrity: Ensure the backup file is intact and has been copied completely to the new system.

Step 4: Connect to the Database Engine on the New System
1. Launch SSMS on the New System: Open SQL Server Management Studio on the new system.
2. Connect to SQL Server: Connect to the SQL Server instance on the new system where you intend to restore the `netXs` database.

Step 5: Restore the Database on the New System
1. Restore Database:
   - In SSMS, right-click on the `Databases` node.
   - Select `Restore Database...`.
   - In the Restore Database window, select `Device` and browse to locate the backup file transferred from the old system.
   - Configure the restore options and specify the destination database name as `netXs`.
   - Click `OK` to start the restore process.
2. Verify Restoration: Ensure the database restoration completes successfully without any errors.

Step 6: Run `netXs` Setup and Install Software
1. Run Setup: Locate the `netXs` setup file on the new system and run the installer.
2. Follow Installation Steps**: Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation of the `netXs` software.

Step 7: Activate the Software
1. Locate Activation and License Keys: Obtain the activation key and license key required for the `netXs` software.
2. Place Keys in Software Folder:
   - Navigate to the installation directory of the `netXs` software.
   - Place the activation key and license key files in the appropriate folder as specified by the software documentation.
Step 8: Connect the Software to SQL Server
1. Configure Database Connection**: Open the `netXs` software and configure the database connection settings.
   - Enter the SQL Server instance name.
   - Provide the necessary authentication details (e.g., username and password).
   - Specify the `netXs` database name.
2. Test Connection: Test the database connection to ensure the `netXs` software can successfully connect to the SQL Server database.
Step 9: Verify Functionality with the Client
1. Check Software Functionality: Perform a series of tests to ensure that the `netXs` software is functioning correctly and can interact with the restored database.
2. Client Verification: Verify with the client that the software is working as expected and that all data has been correctly restored and is accessible.

By following these detailed steps, you should be able to resolve the version compatibility issue, restore the `netXs` database on the new system, and ensure the software is correctly configured and operational.

comments:

6. Now ARSWIN-Net is installed on the new system.

comments:

2. I accessed the Zydus server to check which flag is showing for the transactions on that particular date. 
3. I opened the database and executed the following queries: 
```sql SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='124316'; 
SELECT * FROM attddetails WHERE empid='' AND attddate='2024/06/30'; ``` 
4. I found an 'X' flag for 4 attendance punches, so I modified the process flag in SQL DBX and updated the flag to 'P'. 
5. I opened the attendance sheet, and now all the attendance data is showing properly

```sql SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='124316';

description_plain: As discussed several times, Biomini installation is not working well in my system. Mr Bhavyaraj from Spectra team and Kishorbhai from IT team configured to setting, however the service gets stopped after registering only one figure. Moreover, the I need to re-start the system in order to get the finger scan registered. Kindly help me with the solution to this concern as soon as possible.
comments: The client sent the Teams request, and I joined the meeting to start the BioMini installation. However, the BioMini device is not available, and the IT person is also unavailable at the moment. Therefore, the client has rescheduled the task for Monday.
solution:
1. The client reported that a few days ago, Biomini installation was attempted, but it is not functioning correctly. When attempting to scan a finger, it only works once, and then Spectra client service automatically stops.
2. I requested remote access from them so I could investigate from my location. After some time, the client granted me remote access, and I connected to their system. Upon inspection, I found that Spectra client service was listed in services.msc but was not visible in the control panel, indicating an improper installation.
3. Subsequently, I asked them to uninstall the service. Despite multiple attempts by their IT team and myself, the service continued to appear. I then renamed the Spectra folder to 'old' and initiated a new Biomini installation process.
4. I successfully installed the Spectra client service, but it was initially disabled by policy. Their IT team enabled the service, following which I installed both the service and Biomini Suprema drivers. Now, both are visible in the control panel.
5. After completing the installation, we conducted multiple tests and confirmed that the Biomini device is now functioning correctly.

ticket_title: Issue with Antipassback Feature on Spectra FaceReader
description_plain: Hi Spectra Team,We are using the Spectra FaceReader in our Chennai office, but when I enable the antipassback feature, it shows "Access Granted" even when users swipe twice on the same FaceReader. Ideally, it should show an error like "Access Denied." However, if we swipe twice on the same door, the door will only open once.I am requesting that if any user swipes twice on the same door, it should at least show "Access Denied" or something similar so that employees are aware that they have swiped the same door twice.Please call me and guide me to any settings on the facereader.
comments: We took a remote session with the user and found that the user had set an anti-passback rule for the Face Scribe device. However, when the user punched in twice, no error message was displayed. To rectify this issue, we created a new anti-passback rule and instructed the user to punch in again. Now, when the user punches in twice, it shows an 'Access Denied' error in the logs, but the device itself shows 'Access Granted'. Therefore, we need to discuss this with the developer team.
solution:
I have spoken to the client regarding this issue. In this case, the FaceScribe device is installed as a reader, and the anti-passback feature is functioning correctly. However, when an employee punches in/out for the second time on the device, it shows an "access denied" message instead of the client receiving the event message (access denied due to antipassback) on the iApp software as it should appear on the device.
This functionality  is not available in the FaceScribe device.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: We are currently experiencing a critical issue with our netXs controller software where the user data is not updating correctly. Despite attempts to repair it, the problem persists, and only the old user list is displayed.
comments: Client will connect at 12:30 PM.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that when the user opened the NetXsControl Software, it displayed the error snapshot mentioned below.
To resolve this issue, we opened MS Access and repaired the database.
However, the user's concern is that newly added employees are not appearing in the Employee master list.
Upon investigation, we discovered that the user had added these employees using different user login credentials, resulting in new database MDB files being created in VirtualBox for each user.
To address this, we copied all the MDB files and pasted them into the application folder, and we instructed them to add new employees using the admin login credentials.

name: iApp
description_plain: Due to server error please resolved the issue as soon as possible..
comments:
1. Upon reviewing the screenshot, it appears that a unique key error occurs when attempting to save the gate pass from the registration menu. 
2. To investigate further, I accessed the Zydus server database and executed the following queries to check the visitor count: 
SELECT MAX(id) FROM VISITOR 
SELECT * FROM Sequences WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' 
3. Subsequently, I identified a discrepancy in the visitor count, which was causing the error during the saving process for visitor gate passes. To rectify this issue, I executed the following query to update the count:
UPDATE Sequences SET LastSequence = '' WHERE TypeOfTrans LIKE '%visitor%' --569941 
4. With the visitor count successfully updated, the Visitor Management System (VMS) is now functioning properly.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Iapp System wrong period absent selected during generating text file
description_plain: The client has observed in the iapp System the wrong period of absent days considered while generating a text file through Payroll File Gen-1 in the iapp System. At the time of payroll processing, we have selected two periods 1. Application Sanction & 2. Salary Cycle as per attached screenshot. · Application sanction period –from 26.05.2024 to 26.06.2024. · Salary Cycle period from 26.05.2024 to 25.06.2024 (As per salary cycle for June 24) The below employees were absent on the 26th due to shift change or any other reason/missed punch. The iapp system has considered their absence on 26th June 2024 & generated a log in a Text file. The same text file was uploaded in SAP for payroll processing. But the iapp system will considered absent from the application sanction period from 26.05.2024 to 25.06.2024 instead of the salary cycle period 26.05.2024 to 25.06.2024. 1. 108257 –Santosh Kumar Sharma 2. 110495-Madhu Sudan Goldi 3. 119799-Man Singh
comments:
Earlier in the payroll file generation report, the data gets generated for the regularization as per the salary cycle date where if any application is approved for that period of the salary cycle but now the effect is taken as per the application sanction rule.

For example, if we generate the report of the salary cycle of 26-05-2024 to 25-06-2024 and we select the application sanction date of 26-05-2024 to 27-06-2024 then the data will be generated in the report for the period of the salary cycle and the application sanction for the cycle.
solution: The Issue has been resolved

We also asked the user to attempt to punch on the new device, and they were able to do so successfully.

description_plain: We have granted global access to the above employee (E-Code – 135047) multiple times. Previously, the Spectra team confirmed global access to all locations, but it seems that there are still some locations where global access is not functioning correctly. 2. I opened the software and edited the employee master record, confirming that the disable finger authentication mode was indeed set for this employee.
3. Next, I accessed the assign access menu in the access control and reassigned both local and global access for the employee with the disable finger authentication mode. However, the issue persisted when the employee punched on the device.
4. Subsequently, I accessed the exceptions section in the access control and created a new exception for this employee. I selected the device located at Zydus Technology to disable finger authentication specifically for this employee.
5. I guided them to punch on the attendance device again, confirming that only card mode was accessible for that employee now.

description_plain: When they open the software at that time they getting error no:- 27
comments: Sow given to Ms. Dishita-17/Jul/2024, 17:47
solution: As we checked there is database connection issue. So we open the database and found database were in suspected mode due to direct off the computer or any network connection issue. We repair the database using query 1. ALTER DATABASE canteen SET EMERGENCY , 2. ALTER DATABASE canteen SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE, 3. DBCC CHECKDB(canteen,REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS), 4. ALTER DATABASE canteen SET MULTI_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE, 5. ALTER DATABASE canteen SET ONLINE. Than open the software and download the pending 6K+ transactions. Hence issue has been resolved.

name: iApp
description_plain: The device is not coming online and is showing as offline in the software.
comments:
1. The client reported that both the controller and reader are showing as inactive in the software.
2. I accessed remote access and verified that both the controller and reader were indeed inactive. I proceeded to edit the devices.
3. Upon opening the bootloader application, I searched for the controller and confirmed that the device port was incorrectly set. I updated the device port of the controller, resulting in it showing active status correctly.
4. Despite this, the reader continued to show as inactive. Upon further inspection in the bootloader application, I found that the MAC address of the reader was incorrect. I updated the MAC address of the reader, and now both the controller and reader are displaying as active.
5. I initiated the user dump activity on the controller, and upon completion of the user dump activity, both the controller and reader are now functioning properly.

description_plain: Please find attached screenshot, showing error as per attached Screenshot and there are 32 entries of a Visitor Mr. Navneet Rank and not able to close it.
comments:
1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 70-80 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 
2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from January 1, 2024, to June 19, 2024, and found more than 500 duplicate entries across all Zydus locations. 
3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: 
Select * into Visitor_19072024 from Visitor 
4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: 
Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='1' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 
5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: 
Delete from Visitor where id='575821' 
6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

comments:
1. The client reported an issue where transactions punched on the CP-12 device are incorrectly appearing on the CP-11 device in the system.
2. Upon investigation, I confirmed that both IP addresses are displaying correctly and that both devices are active in the software.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the IP addresses of both devices. It was observed that the CP-11 device's IP address is inactive in the server.
4. I accessed the bootloader application and searched for the CP-12 device. Upon cross-checking the MAC address with the software configuration, I identified that the software was displaying an incorrect MAC address.
5. I updated the MAC address of the CP-12 device, which was physically changed by the client. Additionally, I configured the card format and initiated the user dump process.
6. Please allow some time for the user dump process to complete. Subsequently, the device should be functioning correctly now.

description_plain: Iapp issue
comments: Currently there server was down so we will connect tomorrow.
solution:
The client reported two issues:

1. The first issue was related to employees punching in for 1 or 2 hours but being marked as present for the entire day. Upon remote inspection, I discovered that the shift duration was incorrectly set to 10 hours instead of 10 minutes. I corrected this setting, and the issue has been resolved.

2. The second issue concerned total work hours calculation, where if an employee worked two shifts, only the first and last punch were being considered. Upon remote investigation, I found that the attendance policy was configured to calculate hours based on the first and last punch. I adjusted this setting to calculate based on each swipe/moment recorded.

ticket_title: Mal-functioning of Attendance System while Individual usage. : Neogen Chemicals Ltd., Karakhadi, Tal. Padra, Dist. Vadodara
description_plain: Dear Sir, Please note that after the updation of software, while logged-in by recently joined employees, they are able to see attendance details all employees i.e. Admnistrator log-in authorities. In fact, each and every employee, should see their individual attendance details. This issue is faced by newly joined employees whose registration was pending due to software problem and registered after updating the software. Kindly look into and resolve this issue on urgent basis and confirm.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and identified that when a new employee is added and given ESS login rights, they automatically receive HR Kharakadi rights. To resolve this issue, we checked and found that newly added employees were placed in the HR Kharakadi user group instead of the Webportal group. We manually moved the new employees to the Webportal group.

After investigating further, we discovered that the default user group was set to HR Kharakadi, which caused this issue. Despite changing the default group and saving the changes, it still displayed the HR Kharakadi group. We attempted to resolve the issue by restarting the IIS and Spectra worker process, but the problem persisted.

For reference, snapshots are attached. We need to escalate this issue to the developer and QC team for further investigation and resolution.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and, following L2 guidance, updated to the latest version of the app. However, the reported issue was not resolved. We then performed the following queries, which resolved the issue:

1. `SELECT * FROM DefaultUserGroup WHERE locationid='3' AND companyid='2'`
2. `UPDATE DefaultUserGroup SET groupid='3' WHERE locationid='3' AND companyid='2'`
3. `SELECT * FROM UserGroup WHERE id='4'`

The reported issue has now been resolved.

ticket_title: We can't fetch punching data from face punching machine
description_plain: Dear Sir/Madam, I am Himanshu Patel from Ramdev Chemical Industries, Ankleshwar. We can’t fetch punching data from Spectra’s face punching machine. Please solve this issue urgently. My contact number is mentioned in signature. Thanks &
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that they are using Communicator Soft, but the punch data is not transferring to the third-party Spine system. Upon investigation, we found that the software does not contain data for employees and devices.

We requested remote server access and attempted to log in with the SA account, but the user did not know the password. Therefore, we logged in using Windows authentication and found that the Communicator Soft database is currently in recovery mode.

To resolve this issue, we need the SA password. They will check and then connect us accordingly.
solution:
Certainly! Here’s the corrected sentence:

---

"We took a remote session with the user and found that they wanted to change the server system for the communication software. To do so, we performed the following steps:

1. Installed SQL Express Advanced 2019 on the new system.
2. Reinstalled COMMUNICATION3S and restored the third-party database backup on the new server.
3. Opened the backup application folder and created a new path file.
4. Opened the application and downloaded the executable but found that data was not downloading.
5. Deleted download documents from the database.
6. Deleted machine data from the database.
7. Created a new third-party configuration.

We checked the latest punch data transfer to the third-party table, but data from July 22nd to July 29th was not downloaded and did not appear in the third-party table. We reviewed all the required databases and attempted to recover the data but found nothing. 

8. We updated the application version, but the data for the missing dates was still not found. We informed the user that the data has been lost."

name: iApp
description_plain: Difference in canteen data noticed during review. Date: 19th July.24 Lunch: Lunch count as per Device Display: 302 As per system data: 12 Pl refer attached data sheet for the same.
comments:
1. The client reported that canteen data for July 19, 2024, was not found.
2. Upon generating various reports, I noticed that only 20-22 lunch counts were showing, which is inaccurate compared to the actual count of over 500.   
3. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the log files, and used a log extractor to analyze them. It revealed that canteen punch data was received from the device but was not appearing in the software.   
4. To address this, I filtered the log files specifically for the date July 19th, resulting in 700 log files, which I organized into a new folder.   
5. I meticulously reviewed each of the 700 log files to differentiate those meant for the 3s device and the 2c device.   
6. Subsequently, I created two separate folders named Recover3s and Recover2c to facilitate data recovery, placing the respective log files into each folder based on device compatibility.   
7. Following these steps, I restarted the Spectra worker service and allowed some time for the system to process and recover all pending transactions that were not initially reflected in the software.   
8. After the process completed, all log files were successfully read, and now the canteen transactions are displaying accurately in the software.
solution:
1. The client reported that canteen data for July 19, 2024, was not found.
2. Upon generating various reports, I noticed that only 20-22 lunch counts were showing, which is inaccurate compared to the actual count of over 500.   
3. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the log files, and used a log extractor to analyze them. It revealed that canteen punch data was received from the device but was not appearing in the software.   
4. To address this, I filtered the log files specifically for the date July 19th, resulting in 700 log files, which I organized into a new folder.   
5. I meticulously reviewed each of the 700 log files to differentiate those meant for the 3s device and the 2c device.   
6. Subsequently, I created two separate folders named Recover3s and Recover2c to facilitate data recovery, placing the respective log files into each folder based on device compatibility.   
7. Following these steps, I restarted the Spectra worker service and allowed some time for the system to process and recover all pending transactions that were not initially reflected in the software.   
8. After the process completed, all log files were successfully read, and now the canteen transactions are displaying accurately in the software.

description_plain: This is to inform you that the below-listed visitor passes are suddenly showing a status of CHECK-IN. We check the visitor pass records everydays, but today we observed that 21 passes are pending for check-out. The first three passes have a modified date in the year 2020 and a check-in date in 2024. How can this be possible? And 04 & 05 passes : when we try to check out these passes, we are unable to close due to some error. Request you to resolve the issue. 1 checkedin Abin Pathak 15 checkedin 9974326590 Mr.mitesh Handa 30 checkedin 9099048905 Mr. Vatsal Panchal 547709 checkedin 7778930195 Aadhar card Ashok Singh 566450 checkedin 9537161732 Driving License Sayeed Ahmad 0000000000-1 checkedin 7484834083 Aadhar card Krishna Ji
comments:
1. The client reported that contract employees have had their faces captured in the system 4-5 times, but the photos are still not showing in the employee master.
2. I checked the following two contract employees:
3. **DE00229** - Face is not captured.
   **AJC00040** - Punching is not coming through.
4. I verified the contract employee DE00229, and the face is not showing in the master. For employee AJC00040, the captured face is visible in the master, but access is not working on the device.
solution:
1. The client reported that many visitor IDs have already checked out from the system, but they are still showing as checked in. Additionally, some visitors we tried to check out received an error stating that they were not checked in.
2. I opened the front desk menu in the software and searched for the visitor names one by one based on the information provided by the client.
3. I found that duplicate passes had been generated multiple times, causing the visitors to still show as checked in. When I tried to check out these visitors, an error appeared stating that they were not checked in.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   `SELECT * FROM visitor WHERE locationid='' AND visitid='000000000001'`
5. I found that the status was showing as checked in, so I updated the flag to 'O'. After this update, I was able to successfully check out the visitors from the front desk menu.
6. I repeated the same process for multiple visitors, and the issue has now been resolved.

description_plain: As per Telephonic talk with you kindly share canteen report of Dt.19/07/24.
comments:
1. The client reported that canteen data for July 19, 2024, was not found.
2. Upon generating various reports, I noticed that only 20-22 lunch counts were showing, which is inaccurate compared to the actual count of over 500.   
3. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the log files, and used a log extractor to analyze them. It revealed that canteen punch data was received from the device but was not appearing in the software.   
4. To address this, I filtered the log files specifically for the date July 19th, resulting in 700 log files, which I organized into a new folder.   
5. I meticulously reviewed each of the 700 log files to differentiate those meant for the 3s device and the 2c device.   
6. Subsequently, I created two separate folders named Recover3s and Recover2c to facilitate data recovery, placing the respective log files into each folder based on device compatibility.   
7. Following these steps, I restarted the Spectra worker service and allowed some time for the system to process and recover all pending transactions that were not initially reflected in the software.   
8. After the process completed, all log files were successfully read, and now the canteen transactions are displaying accurately in the software.

name: iApp
description_plain: Request to please help us delete the miss punch of below employee.
comments:
1. The client reported that they were unable to delete the misspunch application because it had already been approved, and the shift punch data was mismatched. 
2. Upon checking the attendance sheet, I discovered that the punch data was incorrect according to the shift. 
3. To address this issue, I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries in the database: 
SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='134775' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='69967' AND attddate='2024/06/26' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
DELETE FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='69967' AND attddate='2024/06/26' AND category = 'mispunch'; 
4. Following this, I reprocessed the attendance, allowing the client to successfully update the punch data.

description_plain: When I try to generate the month-end closure process, it works very slowly.
comments:
1. The client reported that the month-end closure process is stuck and not progressing further.
2. With Setul Sir's assistance, we checked the process from our end and confirmed that it was indeed stuck in the month-end closure.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to check if the process was running:
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM Machinedata (NOLOCK) WHERE commandType = 'Misc_PayrollPipeLine' AND Status = 'P'
   ```
4. I found that the process was running, but it would restart from 1% even after reaching 100%.
5. Upon investigation, I discovered that the Spectra worker was restarting every minute, causing the payroll process to restart.
6. We waited, and after three restarts for one location, the payroll process was successfully completed for that location.
7. I coordinated with the client to start the process for each location one by one. It took some time to complete.
8. The payroll process has now been completed for all locations.

description_plain: 62945 – 25.06, 11.07, 14.07 – Why Attendance not showing correct
comments:
1. The client reported that at the Zydus Technology location, many employees' attendance is showing as half-day present.
2. I reviewed the attendance sheet and found that employees were indeed showing as half-day present. The shift assignments and shift hours are properly defined, but the issue persists.

solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that they were unable to download data in the communicator software. After investigating, we discovered that the devices were offline, which caused the issue. We performed the following steps to resolve the problem: 1. Pinged the device IPs, which were responsive and not conflicting. 2. Checked the device configurations in the application. 3. Deleted download documents from the server. 4. Deleted machine data from the server. 5. Opened the Face portal and verified all configured details. 6. Updated the device firmware to the latest version. 7. Enabled port 1883 on the network. We noted that the user is running the latest version of the communicator (2.0.0.18) and is experiencing this issue. We then copied the Path and Prod type files to the old application folder. Upon opening the software from the old folder, the data started downloading completely. We asked the user to perform a punch test, and confirmed that the data was coming through properly. The user was advised to observe any changes and report back. On the following day, the user reported that while data was downloading, it was not reflecting in the ARS software. To address this, we created the ARS DB path in the communicator software. Data is now properly appearing in the ARS software, but data from July 26th to July 28th was missing in ARS. We found that this data was available in the communicator software but not reflecting in ARS. To resolve this, we executed the following queries to retrieve the missing data in ARS: ```sql SELECT * FROM TransactionData WHERE flgConfig1 IS NULL AND entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; UPDATE TransactionData SET flgConfig1 = NULL WHERE entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; ```

solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that they were unable to download data in the communicator software. After investigating, we discovered that the devices were offline, which caused the issue. We performed the following steps to resolve the problem: 1. Pinged the device IPs, which were responsive and not conflicting. 2. Checked the device configurations in the application. 3. Deleted download documents from the server. 4. Deleted machine data from the server. 5. Opened the Face portal and verified all configured details. 6. Updated the device firmware to the latest version. 7. Enabled port 1883 on the network. We noted that the user is running the latest version of the communicator (2.0.0.18) and is experiencing this issue. We then copied the Path and Prod type files to the old application folder. Upon opening the software from the old folder, the data started downloading completely. We asked the user to perform a punch test, and confirmed that the data was coming through properly. The user was advised to observe any changes and report back. On the following day, the user reported that while data was downloading, it was not reflecting in the ARS software. To address this, we created the ARS DB path in the communicator software. Data is now properly appearing in the ARS software, but data from July 26th to July 28th was missing in ARS. We found that this data was available in the communicator software but not reflecting in ARS. To resolve this, we executed the following queries to retrieve the missing data in ARS: ```sql SELECT * FROM TransactionData WHERE flgConfig1 IS NULL AND entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; UPDATE TransactionData SET flgConfig1 = NULL WHERE entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; ```

1. Pinged the device IPs, which were responsive and not conflicting.
2. Checked the device configurations in the application.
3. Deleted download documents from the server.
4. Deleted machine data from the server.
5. Opened the Face portal and verified all configured details.
6. Updated the device firmware to the latest version.
7. Enabled port 1883 on the network.

We noted that the user is running the latest version of the communicator (2.0.0.18) and is experiencing this issue. We then copied the Path and Prod type files to the old application folder. The user was advised to observe any changes and report back.

SELECT * FROM TransactionData WHERE flgConfig1 IS NULL AND entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00';
UPDATE TransactionData SET flgConfig1 = NULL WHERE entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00';
```

We have informed the user that it may take some time for the data to update, and we requested that they notify us once they receive the data.

comments: Reported issue has been resolved.
solution: We conducted a remote session with the user and found that they were unable to download data in the communicator software. After investigating, we discovered that the devices were offline, which caused the issue. We performed the following steps to resolve the problem: 1. Pinged the device IPs, which were responsive and not conflicting. 2. Checked the device configurations in the application. 3. Deleted download documents from the server. 4. Deleted machine data from the server. 5. Opened the Face portal and verified all configured details. 6. Updated the device firmware to the latest version. 7. Enabled port 1883 on the network. We noted that the user is running the latest version of the communicator (2.0.0.18) and is experiencing this issue. We then copied the Path and Prod type files to the old application folder. Upon opening the software from the old folder, the data started downloading completely. We asked the user to perform a punch test, and confirmed that the data was coming through properly. The user was advised to observe any changes and report back. On the following day, the user reported that while data was downloading, it was not reflecting in the ARS software. To address this, we created the ARS DB path in the communicator software. Data is now properly appearing in the ARS software, but data from July 26th to July 28th was missing in ARS. We found that this data was available in the communicator software but not reflecting in ARS. To resolve this, we executed the following queries to retrieve the missing data in ARS: ```sql SELECT * FROM TransactionData WHERE flgConfig1 IS NULL AND entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; UPDATE TransactionData SET flgConfig1 = NULL WHERE entryDtTime BETWEEN '2024-07-26 00:00:00' AND '2024-07-28 23:59:00'; ```

description_plain: Pls resolve this issue. Every month employee face this issue pls check trail mail and resolve. We need to permanent solution due to employee salary deduct Date 22/07/24 to 25/07/24 continue come in night shift you can check his attendance.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data from 22/07/24 to 25/07/24, is not showing in the attendance sheet. I opened the attendance record of the employee and found that the punches were not showing. I then went to the miscellaneous menu to check all the transactions for that day and found attendance transactions, but they were not showing in the attendance sheet. 
2. I accessed the Zydus server to check which flag is showing for the transactions on that particular date. 
3. I opened the database and executed the following queries: 
SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='124319'; 
SELECT * FROM attddetails WHERE empid=''
4. I found an 'X' flag for 6 attendance punches, so I modified the process flag in SQL DBX and updated the flag to 'P'. 
5. I opened the attendance sheet, and now all the attendance data is showing properly.
solution:
1. The client reported that attendance data from 22/07/24 to 25/07/24, is not showing in the attendance sheet. I opened the attendance record of the employee and found that the punches were not showing. 3. I opened the database and executed the following queries: 
SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='124319'; 
SELECT * FROM attddetails WHERE empid=''
4. I found an 'X' flag for 6 attendance punches, so I modified the process flag in SQL DBX and updated the flag to 'P'.

comments: We took a remote session with the user and learned that they want to install Bio Mini. We attempted to transfer the Bio Mini setup via AnyDesk and UltraViewer, but network issues prevented us from completing the transfer. We created a WeTransfer link, but it was blocked on their end. solution: We have taken the remote session of user and fond that user wants to install bio Mini Set up on two devices , Also ,Client is not having Proper bio mini set up So we have provide our bio mini Setup through We Transfer software. Then we done below steps to install Bio Mini . Step 1 > System must be run by Admin Login Step 2 > Install Spectra Client Setup. Step 3 > Install Spectra Client Driver. Step 3 > Control Panel > Programs & Features > Check Whether Both Setup and drivers installed or not. Step 4 > C Drive > Program files 86 > Spectra (Provide Full Access or rights) > Spectra Client > (Provide Full Access or rights) Step 5 > Bio-mini Folder > Spectra Client folder > Copy all the files . Step 6 > C Drive > Program files 86 > Spectra > Spectra Client > Paste all the files. Step 7 > Bio Mini Folder > Spectra Driver folder > Copy all the files except last two Library files. Step 8 > C Drives > Window > System 32 > Paste all the files Step 9 > C Drives > Window > SosWow64 > Paste all the files Step 10 > Install remaining two library from the Spectra Driver folder Step 11 > Open the I app and get the finger.

description_plain: Pls note that we are unable to capture the data from below mention machine. Kindly arrange to resolve the same at the earliest. 192.168.78.74 & Gn-pkg
comments:
1. The client reported that the GN-PKG device has been showing as inactive since the 26th, which is why attendance data is not being displayed.
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device was showing as offline.
3. I accessed the Zydus server and pinged the IP address; it responded properly and was active.
4. I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and found that the device server port was set incorrectly. I updated the server port to 9997.
5. The device is now showing as active, and pending transactions will clear after some time.
6. The device's fingerprint capacity is showing only 10, so the user dump process needs to be started and allowed to complete.
7. After completing the user dump process, the device is now working fine.

ticket_title: NSBT tower - Punch in and out not reflecting
description_plain: NSBT tower - Punch in and out not reflecting
comments:
During the remote session, we found that the employee's punch data is not reflecting in the attendance sheet because the devices are offline. 

We pinged the device IP, but it did not respond. We have requested the IT team to ping the device IP as this appears to be a network issue.

However, Client  require a hardware engineer to visit in order to rectify this issue.
solution:
As per my today's visit at your premises regarding reported issues, Please find summary and our observations below:

    Unit-1 5th floor Controller 4 & 5 having IP 68,69 not connected with Server -- No issue found in Spectra HW, The IP consumed by other HW and conflicting, So as instructed by ISS/Network Team we have changed IP as 82, 83 and now connected with Server as confirmed by HR Team.

    MBF Building's 10 controller not connected with Server -- No issue found in Spectra HW, the connectivity between NW switch to Server main switch was disconnected and now ISS/Network team has fixed the connectivity issue. All controllers are auto connected with Server as confirmed by HR Team.

    Maintenance Team Access issue in Unit-2 Hub Rooms -- No issue found in Spectra HW MST team access is working fine as confirmed by Maintenance Team, we found that Hub room's EDR(Emergence Door Glass) are broken. that's why access was not working. I have guided to Maintenance Team to fix same by taping the Glass.
    Unit -2 3rd Floor Training Room Device Issue -- Device is already send for Repairing purpose, Spectra eng. will install same once received from R&D center.

description_plain: Please connect us with the support team. We are having some open operational issues.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that there was an issue where employees working the night shift had their 'Out' punches recorded as the 'In' punches for the next day. We checked the shift settings and found that the user had overlapping Day Shift (8:00 AM to 8:00 PM) and Night Shift (8:00 PM to 8:00 AM) schedules, with a maximum of 16 work hours. This overlap was causing the punch issue.

To resolve this, we created a new Day Shift (8:01 AM to 7:59 PM) and Night Shift (8:00 PM to 8:00 AM) with a maximum of 12 hours. Here’s what we did:
1. Created a new shift in the app: **I App > Attendance > Shift & Leave Types > Shift > New**.
2. Created a new shift pattern: **I App > Attendance > Policy > Shift Pattern > New**.
3. Assigned the new shift to one employee for testing: **I App > Attendance > Assignment > Policy Mapping > Select Employee > Assign Policy > Save**.
4. Reprocessed the records for the dates where the user had issues: **I App > Attendance > Operation > Attendance Sheet > Select Employee > Select Record > Right-click > Reprocess the Record**.

The punch records are now showing correctly. We have advised the user to apply this new policy to all employees and reprocess all records where issues were identified."

comments: Need to validate with the internal team.
solution:

2. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:
   SELECT * FROM adjustapply WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024-07-22'
3. I did not find any leave application in the database, so I executed the following query to check for stuck commands in the backend:   SELECT * FROM attdmain WHERE empid='' AND attddate='2024-07-22'   ```
4. I found that the wrong command flag was showing in the leaveid and leavevalue fields, so I updated the flag to NULL.
5. The leave has been removed, and the attendance sheet is now displaying correctly.

   ```sql
   DELETE FROM usersettings (nolock) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM UserMaster WHERE username='100860') AND category='Filtering'
5. After making these changes, I logged in with the user account, and the attendance sheet is now opening properly.

ticket_title: Changes required in ESS system - Important
description_plain: As we discussed, We are looking to shift our attendance regularization window to 21st to 20th dates as against the current configuration which is of 1-30/31st of the month. Keeping this change in the system, pls confirm how ESS system can be configured/modified for SBIC: How can we lock/freeze the month end date with this change logic. Currently we put last date of the month after running the leave inputs of any of the month What would be the treatment for Average hours logic for non-roster employee and any other impact to roster/non-roster employees by doing the required changes Is there any impact on SFTP configuration after this change Post changing, still the comp off parameters/number of comp-off would remain same or there would be some changes Any impact on the mobile app functionality Changes on any other reports like average, continuous absent, comp off ledger etc. What would be treatment on the buffer/left over days while implementing this change Please do the complete validation and RCA on every related aspects/correspondence coding before confirming, as we do not want any lapsation thus ending with the manual reconciliation Connect for any further assistance or clarity if needed in regard to this matter.
comments: Forwarding to the L2
solution:
As per suggest payroll cycle previous month 16 to next month 15 we have checked in our environment with latest application version for below point:

1.  How can we lock/freeze the month end date with this change logic. Currently we put last date of the month after running the leave inputs of any of the month.

Spectra comment : Currently you are lock month from month closer option with  previous month last date like 30 or 31. After changing payroll cycle as per above mention you will lock month 

up to 15 so you will lock the month with date 15.

 2.  What would be the treatment for Average hours logic for non-roster employee and any other impact to roster/non-roster employees by doing the required changes.

Spectra comment : Avg work hour policy will working on new payroll cycle as per mention above.

3.  Is there any impact on SFTP configuration after this change.

Spectra comment : There  is not any impact on SFTP configuration.

4.   Post changing, still the comp off parameters/number of comp-off would remain same or there would be some changes.

Spectra comment : We will change pay roll cycle so there is not any impact in comp off , comp off validity calculated based on comp off / overtime policy.

5.  Any impact on the mobile app functionality

Spectra comment : No impact.

6. Changes on any other reports like average, continuous absent, comp off ledger etc.

Spectra comment :  No Impact.

7.  What would be treatment on the buffer/left over days while implementing this change.

Spectra comment :  Yon can take up by manually, system will calculated previous month also after new  payroll cycle implemented.

8. Please do the complete validation and RCA on every related aspects/correspondence coding before confirming, as we do not want any lapsation thus ending with the manual reconciliation

Spectra comment : We have test scenario in our test environment with latest application version, if you have any dout we will change payroll cycle in UAT  link of SBIC and you can validate the 

same and dully confirm on it.

Kindly note that in SBIC UAT link is working on latest application version and Production link is working on OLD application version, if you will test the scenario in UAT server so please 

restore production database in UAT server so we will update OLD application version in UAT server which is running Production server and change the payroll cycle as per new requirement.

comments: internal checking required
solution:
As per suggest payroll cycle previous month 16 to next month 15 we have checked in our environment with latest application version for below point:

1.  How can we lock/freeze the month end date with this change logic. Currently we put last date of the month after running the leave inputs of any of the month.

Spectra comment : Currently you are lock month from month closer option with  previous month last date like 30 or 31. After changing payroll cycle as per above mention you will lock month 

up to 15 so you will lock the month with date 15.

 2.  What would be the treatment for Average hours logic for non-roster employee and any other impact to roster/non-roster employees by doing the required changes.

Spectra comment : Avg work hour policy will working on new payroll cycle as per mention above.

3.  Is there any impact on SFTP configuration after this change.

Spectra comment : There  is not any impact on SFTP configuration.

4.   Post changing, still the comp off parameters/number of comp-off would remain same or there would be some changes.

Spectra comment : We will change pay roll cycle so there is not any impact in comp off , comp off validity calculated based on comp off / overtime policy.

5.  Any impact on the mobile app functionality

Spectra comment : No impact.

6. Changes on any other reports like average, continuous absent, comp off ledger etc.

Spectra comment :  No Impact.

7.  What would be treatment on the buffer/left over days while implementing this change.

Spectra comment :  Yon can take up by manually, system will calculated previous month also after new  payroll cycle implemented.

8. Please do the complete validation and RCA on every related aspects/correspondence coding before confirming, as we do not want any lapsation thus ending with the manual reconciliation

restore production database in UAT server so we will update OLD application version in UAT server which is running Production server and change the payroll cycle as per new requirement.

description_plain: Mismatch in swipe records || Ticket No:T011047
comments:
Client Issue (A). Punch is Getting moved to the next day.

Identification of Spectra:- 

1. We have found that the shift was not properly defined to the user as per the punch done, i.e., the user has punch for the night shift (Night shift 3:00 PM to 3:00 am) and the shift was assigned as the General shift due to which the punch is getting moved.

2. As the shift was not properly assigned to the user the working hours are also not getting calculated.

3. Also we have found that the Maximum work hours are shown as 16 hours and the user's work hours are more than.

Solution:-

For 1(A) and 2(A) Points, We have guided to assign the policy to the user who is working on the night shift and was assigned to the General shift. Also, we have provided the Import file for the policy update in bulk for more users and if there are few users then the user can assign the policy from Policy mapping (Path:- Attendance module > Assignment > Policy mapping > select the user and click over assign policy > select the check box and update the policy with the effective date they want to update).

For 3(A) Point, we have to change the maximum working hours from 16 to 20 in shift policy for only one location i.e. Gurgaon for other locations if required then the user can change as per the following path

Path:- Attendance module > Shift & Leave type > Shift > location search and edit it > change the maximum hours and click over save.

Client Issue (B). In the attendance details report, the data is not shown properly.

Identification of Spectra:-

1. We have found that due to the shift assigned was not proper.

2. In the report 2 fields were required i.e. Location and remark for only Present data and a single punch done on any date by the user to validate.

Solution:-

For 1(B) Point, we have guided to change the policy from General to Night shift in all the users who are coming at Night only. after this change, the user who comes in a different shift needs to be taken up manually by the shift change application through users or admin.

For 2(B) We have added both the fields in the report and showed them after generating it.

Moreover, there was an issue in the Movement Horizontal report, where the data is shown in 2 rows but after the maximum shift hours are set to 20 for the Gurgaon Location the data is shown properly in the report and the punch has also moved to the actual date in a spreadsheet.

We have also guided that there are 2 different modules and havihaveferent reports as per Module Wise. If they want to check the attendance date through the report then they need to open the report of the attendance module only (Path:- Attendance Module > Report > Reports New) and if they want to check data regarding Access Control then they need to check from Access Control module (Path:- Access Control > Reports > Reports).

name: iApp
description_plain: PDN and update already reporting manger change but till pending at system.
comments:
1. The client reported that many overtime applications are showing as pending in the system for employee ID 115327.
2. I opened the user hierarchy and checked the overtime hierarchy and found that the approval manager is already defined in the hierarchy.
3. After that, I opened the attendance sheet of the employee and found that many of the extra hours worked by the employee do not comply with the overtime policy assigned to the employee.
4. I found 3-4 applications where the extra hours worked were in accordance with the overtime policy, but in the overtime/COFF menu, they are still showing as pending in the system.
5. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query to clear all pending overtime applications:
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
   AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-06-26' AND '2024-08-06'
6. I found over 30,000 applications, so I executed the update query:
   ```sql
   UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1
   AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-06-26' AND '2024-08-06'
7. I waited for some time to clear all the pending overtime applications.
solution: As we checked, the final overtime approval for the employee has been removed from the system, which is why the overtime applications are still showing as pending.
