description_plain: Pls find below details as per trail mail Punch not show in I-app. First shift out time . Pls check and need to resolve this issue.
comments:
1. The client reported that one employee's attendance punch is not showing for the date of 06/08/2024.
2. I opened the employee master menu, went to the miscellaneous menu, and searched the transactions, but only the punch for that day is showing.
3. After that, I opened the attendance sheet and reprocessed the attendance, but the punch is still not showing.
4. I need access to the Zydus server to check the log files and extract the data.
solution:
1. The client reported that the out punch is not showing for that employee on the date of 06/08/2024.
2. I opened the employee master menu, edited the employee details, and went to the miscellaneous menu, where I found that only in punches are showing for that day.
3. I then opened the attendance sheet and saw that no up-down punches are available for the same day.
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the Spectra application setup services, and copied all the data log files for the date 06/08/2024.
5. I created a folder, pasted all the files into it, and extracted all the log files using the log extractor.
6. I filtered the data by employee card ID but did not find the out punch in the log files. I have shared these details with the client.

description_plain: Kindly rectify the issues and resolve ASAP. Location: ALIDAC Punch Machine Location: CW Main gate Error: Finger not found
comments: The client reported that the CW device is showing a "finger not found" error. I checked from here but need to run a user dump activity on the device. Currently, the user dump activity is running on another device, so please wait a bit.
solution:
1. The client reported that the CW device is not working and is showing a "finger not found" error.
2. I opened the database menu in the software and found that the device is showing as active, but it displays only 10 fingers, whereas the actual number is over 700, indicating a deviation in employee fingerprints.
3. I started the user dump process on the device and waited for it to complete.
4. After the user dump process was completed, I reset the card format on the device, and now it is working properly.

description_plain: Please find attached photo of access reader it is not working properly, after set the card format of the device still same error showing. Kindly depute your engineer on priority.
comments:
1. The client reported a bit pattern error showing on the reader device.
2. I requested remote access to check the issue from here. After receiving remote access, I checked both the controller and reader in the database menu software, and both devices appeared active and functioning correctly.
3. I then navigated to the card format menu and set the card format for both the controller and reader, but the same error persisted.
4. I discussed the issue with Jatin Sir, who suggested performing a factory reset on both the controller and reader. I followed his advice and initiated the user dump process on the controller.

description_plain: The punch of lady guard Smt. Lakshmi Balani ( Emp code - Pio0036 ) is still not activated, entry denied is being shown. Cw device. Please resolve this issue.
comments:
1. I checked the employee master, and the fingerprint data is showing correctly.
2. I then accessed the "Get Finger" menu, fetched the fingerprints, and found two fingerprints available on the device.
3. I proceeded to the "Assign Access" menu, reassigned access to them, and confirmed that the access command was successful.
solution:
1. The client reported that the fingerprint access is not working for the contract employee PIO0036 (Lakshmi Balani). I opened the database page in the software and found that the CW device is active and functioning properly.
2. After that, I accessed the contract master menu and checked the fingerprint data, finding that 4 fingerprints are available.
3. I discussed with Jatin Sir about the fingerprint capacity of the Bioscribe 2C-1M and 4M devices. The 1M device has a capacity of up to 1900 fingerprints, while the 4M device has a capacity of up to 9000 fingerprints.
4. I went to the assign access menu and reassigned access to the contract employee, and the command was executed successfully.

name: iApp
description_plain: Employee ID 148119 encounters an issue where, upon trying to log in to the iApp, it displays a message stating that the user is not authorized for this page.
comments:
1. The client reported that login is not working for employee ID 148119, and it displays "unauthorized user" on the web page.
2. I requested the client to provide the login credentials so I could check from my end.
3. After receiving the login credentials, I attempted to log in but found that it was still not working.
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries to check for any filters:
   - `SELECT * FROM UserMaster (NOLOCK) WHERE empid='145'`
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings WHERE category LIKE '%UserDefaultURL%' AND id='193'`
   - `SELECT * FROM usersettings (NOLOCK) WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM UserMaster WHERE username='Security02') AND category='Filtering'`
5. No incorrect filters were found affecting the user’s login.
6. I checked the software, navigated to the user group, and selected the web portal. I found that the user was not listed in the web portal, so I added the user to the web portal with their ID and password. After this, the login issue was resolved and is now working properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please help two new punching machine installation at ZHOPL, kindly configure the punch machine
comments: In accordance with AMC team policy, I request that the client provide the serial numbers of the devices they wish to install in the system.
solution:
1. According to the AMC response, these devices are newly purchased, and hardware support has been approved by the AMC team.
2. I began the device configuration process by first checking the IP connectivity of both devices using the Zydus server.
3. After successfully pinging the IP addresses, I opened the Bootloader application, located the Bioscribe 2C devices (hardware 2 devices), set the device parameters, and updated the firmware for both devices.
4. I then opened the software, added the new devices to the Access Control module, and saved all device parameters and commands, which were executed successfully.
5. I accessed the Device Operation menu and performed a factory reset on both devices from the front end.
6. I set the card format on both devices and proceeded to the Attendance Settings menu to add them as attendance devices.
7. I opened the Access Groups and included both devices in the attendance access group.
8. I went to the Database menu in the software, initiated the user dump process for both devices one by one, and waited for the process to complete.
9. Once the dump process was finished, employees punched in on both devices, and the attendance transactions are now appearing in the attendance sheet.

name: iApp
description_plain: Kindly provide canteen (Lunch) data for the month of July on dated 01.07.2024. 01 July canteen data is not showing in report .
comments:
1. The client reported that the canteen count for July 1st is not displaying correctly; it only shows 7 dinner counts, which is inaccurate.
2. I opened the canteen report in the software, generated the 'Item Consumption Periodic Report' for July 1st, selecting both the canteen and items. The report only showed 7 item consumptions, which is incorrect.
3. I checked the database menu in the software and confirmed that both canteen devices are showing as active.
4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the application services menu, and opened the data log files. I filtered for 'Cdata' (canteen data) and copied all files from July 1st, 2024.
5. I created a new log folder and extracted the files using the log extractor application. I found a large amount of data, so I filtered it by the two canteen devices located at the Daman site. I copied the data from the log extractor and created a new 'Recover3S' folder in the services directory, pasting all files for both devices into this folder.
6. I then stopped the Spectra Worker service. Once the service was completely stopped, I restarted it, allowing it to read the canteen data one by one.
7. I reopened the software and regenerated the report, and the data is now displaying correctly.

4. I accessed the Zydus server, went to the application services menu, and opened the data log files. I filtered for 'Cdata' (canteen data) and copied all files from July 1st, 2024.

name: iApp
description_plain: Please note that Ravindra Sir’s out time has not been recorded from 5th-8th August (as per below mentioned screenshot). Kindly help to regularize the same.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance out punches were not showing from August 5th to August 8th.
2. I checked the system and opened the Employee Master menu, then selected the Miscellaneous menu and reviewed the device transactions, but out transactions were not appearing in the software.
3. I then accessed the Database menu and discovered that one device, which handles out transactions, was marked as inactive, causing the transactions to be pending.
4. I examined the Zydus server and verified that the IP address was correct. Upon opening the bootloader application, I found that the server port configuration on the device was incorrect.
5. I updated the server port configuration and reconfigured the device. The device is now active, so I allowed some time for all pending transactions to clear. Afterward, all data began showing properly.
solution:
1. The client reported that attendance out punches were not showing from August 5th to August 8th.
2. I checked the system and opened the Employee Master menu, then selected the Miscellaneous menu and reviewed the device transactions, but out transactions were not appearing in the software.
3. I then accessed the Database menu and discovered that one device, which handles out transactions, was marked as inactive, causing the transactions to be pending.
4. I examined the Zydus server and verified that the IP address was correct. Upon opening the bootloader application, I found that the server port configuration on the device was incorrect.
5. I updated the server port configuration and reconfigured the device. The device is now active, so I allowed some time for all pending transactions to clear. Afterward, all data began showing properly.

name: iApp
description_plain: We would like to bring to your attention an issue that has been increasingly affecting our attendance system at the ZCP, PTC site. Several employees have reported difficulties with the Card + Finger punch system, particularly with the 3S machines. The main issue reported is that the system frequently displays the error message "Finger not found" when employees attempt to punch in. This problem appears to be more prevalent with the 3S machines, whereas the 2C machines are functioning correctly. As the number of complaints has been growing, it is crucial that we address this issue promptly to avoid further disruption to our attendance tracking process. Could you please look into this matter as soon as possible? If you require any additional information or assistance from our end, please don't hesitate to reach out.
comments:
1. According to Mr. Jignesh Prajapati, the fingerprints of the employees have already been captured using Biomni, and the user dump activity has been completed. However, at the Zydus Corporate Park location, 80-100 employees are encountering an error indicating "finger not found" specifically with the Bio-Scribe 3S devices.
2. I requested 2-3 employee IDs to check from my end and verify whether the error persists. 
3. Mr. Jignesh mentioned that we will address this concern tomorrow, and he will provide the employee IDs for further live scenario testing.
solution: We checked multiple times with the client, removed access, re-enrolled the fingerprints, and then reassigned access to the employees. All BioScribe 3S device access is now working correctly, and the observation is complete.
